strings.Susano-o>>\n…今回までは見逃してやる…。\n次は無ェからな……！:
Susano-o>>
...I'll let it slide this time...
There won't be a next time......!
strings.Susano-o>>\nおいおい、４匹もいるのかよ。\nちぃと手間だが、まとめて:
Susano-o>>
Whoa, there's 4 of 'em?
Kind of a hassle, but I'll
take you all on at once!
strings.Susano-o>>\nお前なかなか根性あるじゃねぇか！\nおもしれぇ！:
Susano-o>>
You've got some real guts!
This is fun!
strings.Susano-o>>\nくそっ！ 集中力が切れちまったぜ！:
Susano-o>>
Dammit! I lost my concentration!
strings.Susano-o>>\nこいつはまた楽しめそうなヤツがでたな！\n存分に暴れてや:
Susano-o>>
Now here's another one who looks fun!
I'm gonna go wild!
strings.Susano-o>>\nご、誤解だ！\n俺の話を聞けって！:
Susano-o>>
Y-you've got it wrong!
Just listen to me!
strings.Susano-o>>\nしつこいぞ…！ 俺を行かせぬ気か！:
Susano-o>>
You're persistent...! You
won't let me through!?
strings.Susano-o>>\nそうだな……。\n俺もこの先に用事があるんだ。:
Susano-o>>
Yeah, well......
I've got business up ahead too.
strings.Susano-o>>\nだが、決着はつけさせてもらう。\nこの先で待つ！:
Susano-o>>
But we're still settling this.
I'll be waiting up ahead!
strings.Susano-o>>\nったく……お前にも迷惑かけたな。\nここでお別れだが、こ:
Susano-o>>
Geez...... sorry for the trouble.
This is where we part, but
don't you die out there!
strings.Susano-o>>\nったく！ \nうっとおしいったらないぜ！:
Susano-o>>
Geez!
What a pain in the neck!
strings.Susano-o>>\nてめぇら！\n力が溜まるまで、俺を守りやがれ！:
Susano-o>>
You lot!
Protect me till my power's charged up!
strings.Susano-o>>\nまた水を差されたような気もするが…。\n今回ばかりは感謝:
Susano-o>>
Feels like someone
spoiled my fun again...
But just this once, I'm grateful...!
strings.Susano-o>>\nまだまだ暴れ足りネェのよ！\n次は何してくれてやるかな…:
Susano-o>>
I haven't had nearly
enough of a rampage!
What should I do to you next...!
strings.Susano-o>>\nよぉ姉上！\n久しぶりに会いに来たぜぇ！:
Susano-o>>
Yo, sis!
Came to see you after all this time!
strings.Susano-o>>\nアァッ？ 何邪魔してくれてんだ！？\n…カッ、気分悪ィな:
Susano-o>>
Huh? What're you
getting in my way for!?
...Tch, that ruined my
mood... I'll come back later!
strings.Susano-o>>\nオイ！ どういうつもりだ…？:
Susano-o>>
Oi! What's the big idea...?
strings.Susano-o>>\nグゥッ…、ニンゲンッ！ \nこんな…、時までッ……！:
Susano-o>>
Guh..., human!
Even at a time... like this......!
strings.Susano-o>>\n上等！ 吹っ飛ばしてやる！\n二度と悪さが出来ぬようにな:
Susano-o>>
Bring it! I'll blow you away!
So you can never do harm again!
strings.Susano-o>>\n折角だから一緒に行こうじゃねぇか！:
Susano-o>>
Since we're at it, why
don't we go together!
strings.Susano-o>>\n相手してやる。\nせいぜい楽しませろよな！:
Susano-o>>
I'll take you on.
Try to keep me entertained!
strings.Susano-o>>\n認めねぇ……認めねぇぞ……。\n俺は絶対に……認めねぇ。:
Susano-o>>
I won't accept it... I
won't accept it......
I will never... accept it.
strings.Susano-o>>\n退け退け！ 邪魔をするな！\n退かぬなら吹き飛ばしてやる:
Susano-o>>
Out of the way, out of
the way! Don't interfere!
If you won't move, I'll blow you away!
strings.Susano-o>>\n遠くの国に行く用事ができたから、\nその前に会いたかった:
Susano-o>>
I've got to go to a faraway land,
so I just wanted to
see you before that!

strings.´（ダッシュ）が付いている所がミソ…なのよね。\n浮けるし、移動早くなるし…見え:
The key part is that it has
a ' (dash) on it... right.
You can float, you move faster...
and you can see things, right?
All sorts of things.
Honestly! What an
incredible pervert! Dummy!
strings.…\nさてね、私は答を知るわけじゃない。:
...
Who knows. I don't know the answer.
strings.……\nあっけなく解除出来たっパ……！:
......
That came undone way too easily-pa...!
strings.…… きこえますか… きこえますか…\n<PCName>…:
...Can you hear me...
Can you hear me...
<PCName>...
strings.……<PCName>。\nこのＣＯＭＰはお前が持っていろ。:
......<PCName>.
You hold on to this COMP.
strings.……………………先のらいぶ、\n妖精殿の説法は骨身に染みた…………。:
..........The recent "lai-bu"...
The fairy's sermon struck me
to the very bone..........
strings.…………。\nしかし、まだ足りないようです。:
..........
But it seems it's still not enough.
strings.…………あちらの世界に用があるなら\nもう少しだけ時を待つんだな。:
..........If you've got
business in that world,
wait just a little longer.
strings.…………ばんど……？\n雅楽の一種であろうか。:
..........A "ban-do"...?
Is it a form of gagaku court music?
strings.…………法堂には既に、\nお主のお連れが居る模様…………。:
..........It seems your companions
are already in the
dharma hall..........
strings.………いいだろう。\nよく応えたオマエに一つ教えておこう。:
.........Very well.
Since you answered well,
I'll tell you one thing.
strings.………こんにちは……。\n今おやつ中なの。\n食べ終わるまで、ちょっと待ってもら:
.........Hello......
I'm having a snack right now.
Would you mind waiting a
bit until I finish eating?
strings.………そうだな。\n多くの血が流れた後は特に、だ。:
.........That's right.
Especially after a lot of
blood has been spilled.
strings.……、まぁ、いいだろう。\n連れて来たことに違いは無い。:
......Well, fine.
You did bring it, no doubt about that.
strings.……。\nあ、デビルバスター。\nまた会った。\nデビルバスターはまだ戦っている:
...
Ah, Devil Buster.
We met again.
Are you still fighting, Devil Buster?
...
Hmm.
Hey.
I have a favor to ask you, Devil Buster.
Will you listen?

...

We met again.

Not free?

Hey.

...
Ah, Devil Buster.
I meet you a lot, Devil Buster.
Do you want to see Inori?
Or are you killing time?
Are you still fighting?
...
Hey.
I have a favor to ask you, Devil Buster.

...

a lot, Devil Buster.
Why?
Are you always looking for Inori?

for you, Devil Buster?
Curious...
...
Hey.

If there were no reason,
we wouldn't meet this much.

there's a big cat...

something that soothes one,"

so I PREPARED an item

attention to your surroundings.

All I remember...
are the words "Nakano" and "Yaginuma."
Hmm...
Maybe if you went to "Nakano,"
you'd find something out.
What do you think?
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nありがとうございます。\n楽しんでいただけました？\nも:
Oh, really?
Thank you.
Did you enjoy yourself?
If there was anything bad
about it, please tell me.
I'll be sure to pass it on.
I'm counting on you.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nあれ……でも「ピクシー」ちゃんって、\nいつもお友達と遊:
Oh, I see.
Huh... but I always pictured "Pixies"
playing with their
friends all the time...
Is my picture of them wrong?
...Where did I go wrong...
Thank you for telling me.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nうーん……。\nということはデビルバスターさんなら、\n:
Oh, I see.
Hmm...
So that means they're not something
any Devil Buster can easily get...
Who could have made those
seals, and for what?
That part is a mystery.
I'll think about it a bit.
Thank you for answering.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nそこまではわかりませんでした。\nでも珍しいですよね。子:
Oh, really?
I didn't know that much.
But it's unusual, isn't
it? Child Innocents.
About Innocents,
I was told they're beings
created only for labor.
And yet... children...
I'd think children wouldn't
be much use for labor.
Why would Innocents like that be born?
...Maybe someone just liked children.
Oh, thank you for telling me.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nそっか……私だけそう思ってるんじゃなかったんだ。\nやっ:
Oh, really?
I see... so I'm not the only
one who feels that way.
It's scary when you think
they might attack, isn't it?
Yeah... I'm a little relieved.
Thank you for answering.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nそれはいいことですね。\nちゃんと体を大切にしてあげてく:
Oh, is that so?
That's good to hear.
Please take good care of your body.
...It's a bit strange coming from
someone with a sore throat, but...
Please do.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nそんな種類があるなんて初めて聞きました。\nあ……やっぱ:
Oh, really?
This is the first I've heard
there are other kinds.
Oh... are the gold ones expensive?
If so, that's just like people.
Like how we like shiny things.
Thinking about it that way is fun.
Thank you for telling me.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nでも……そうですよね。\nただでさえ探索自体が大変なのに:
Oh, I see.
But... I guess that makes sense.
Exploring is hard enough as it is,
you wouldn't really
think about timing it.
There's no point in pushing
yourself and getting hurt...
But if you get the chance,
why not try it once?
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\nなんとなくいつも楽しそうに空を飛んでますよね。\nあの姿:
Oh, you have?
They always seem to be flying
around happily, don't they?
Whenever I see them like
that, I always admire them...
Someday I want to look naturally cute
like a "Kahaku" too...
That feels like a long
way off, though... ugh...
Now I'm a little sad,
but I'll do my best.
I'm sorry.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n何か分かり難いところに居たりするって聞いた事があります。:
Oh, I see.
I heard he's somewhere hard to find.
If you'd like, why not
try looking for him?
He might tell you some
valuable information.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n凄いですね。\n非凡って呼ばれるなんて……。\nきっとも:
Oh, really?
That's amazing.
To be called extraordinary...
It must be overflowing with talent.
It's just like people...
that's interesting.
Thank you for telling me.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n可愛い悪魔さんならまだいいんですけど、\nちょっと怖かっ:
Oh, I see.
It's fine if the demons are cute, but
when they're a little scary...
N-Never mind. Please forget it.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n基本的な訓練とか凄く大事ですよね。\nそういうのをしっか:
Oh, I see.
Basic training is really important.
If you don't do it properly,
you'll be in trouble
when something happens.
Especially for Devil Busters,
it seems like it could be a
matter of life and death...
Um, please try not to get hurt.
But do your best!
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n時々この街なかで、\nいつもより小さい悪魔さんを連れてる:
Oh, I see.
Sometimes in town,
there are people with demons
smaller than usual...
So those were immature demons.
I'm glad I understand now.
Thank you for telling me.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n確かこの街の入り口の近くに居たはずです。\nもしよかった:
Oh, I see.
I'm pretty sure she was near
the entrance to this town.
If you'd like, try
looking for her later.
She's beautiful, you know.
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n私もこのまえあるデビルバスターさんに聞いただけなので、\:
Oh, really?
I only heard about it from a
Devil Buster the other day,
so I don't really know the details.
It might even be a lie...
But if you ever meet
them, please tell me.
I'm really curious what
kind of children they are.
I wonder if they're cute...
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n羨ましいですね。\n私のお友達とかもお酒好きな子がいるん:
Oh, really?
I'm jealous.
I have some friends who love drinking,
and they always look like
they're enjoying it.
Seeing that makes me want to drink too,
but I fall asleep right
away, so I can't.
What's the difference, I wonder?
Hmm... I want to be able to drink...
strings.あ、そうなんですか。\n街中で悪魔さんを見る機会が今まであまり無かったので、\n:
Oh, I see.
I haven't had many chances to
see demons in town before,
so it surprised me a little...
I'm sorry.
strings.あ、そうなんですか！\nでもそうですよね。\n私みたいなのにこうして何回も話しか:
Oh, really!
But of course.
You're someone who talks to someone
like me again and again like this.
I'm sure all sorts of people can tell
you have a really warm heart.
Please always treasure that warm heart.
strings.あ、そうなんですか！\nやっぱり美味しいですよね。\n気がつくとずっと食べてたり:
Oh, you do!
It's delicious, isn't it?
Before I know it, I've
been eating it nonstop.
I know I should cut back a bit...
But I'm a little weak-willed and
my hand just reaches for it.
Please keep this between us.
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\nでも確かに凄く危ない所ですからね……。\nちゃんと準備と:
Oh, really?
But it is a really dangerous place...
Once you're properly
prepared, try going then.
It's a really dangerous
place, so be very careful.
Promise me.
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\nでも確かに凄く危ない所ですからね……。\n怖い人とかが沢:
Oh, really?
Well, it is a really dangerous place...
There are lots of scary people.
Once you're properly prepared,
please try going there.
It really is a dangerous
place, so be very careful.
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\nやっぱり一人よりも楽しいですしね。\n困ったときとか助け:
Oh, really?
It's more fun than
being alone, after all.
Getting help when you're in
trouble, helping others...
Hmm... that feeling of having
comrades is really nice.
Please treasure that clan.
Please.
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\n何でもこの「トウキョウ」の何処かに海があるらしいんですよ:
Oh, really?
Apparently there's a sea
somewhere in this "Tokyo."
They said something about some woman...
Why don't you try looking for it?
If you find out anything,
please tell me.
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\n夜が好きな人って多いですよね。\n星とか月とか凄い綺麗で:
Oh, really?
Lots of people like the night.
The stars and moon are
really beautiful...
But... I don't know why...
I just can't quite settle
my heart at night.
Hmm... am I weird?
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\n山羊屋さんってこの街にも居るってききましたけど……。\n:
Oh, really?
I heard there's a Goat
merchant in this town too...
I'm surprised there's an
amazing explorer so close by.
I'll try talking to him next time.
I wonder what Relics
of the Old World are?
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\n確かこの街の何処かの建物に入っていったんですけど、\n何:
Oh, really?
I think they went into some
building in this town,
but I forgot which one.
I'm sorry I couldn't be of help.
If you explore around
town, you might find them.
If you'd like, why not look for them?
strings.あ、そうなんですか？\n私も実物を見たことはないんですけど、そういう話は聞きまし:
Oh, really?
I've never seen one in person
either, but I've heard about it.
It's kind of interesting, right?
Like disguising yourself as a really
scary demon and surprising someone...
It seems like it'd be
handy for Halloween.
That sounds fun...
strings.あ、そこにある梯子は\n使ってはいけないでありますよ。:
Oh, you mustn't use
that ladder there, sir.
strings.あ、そっちがいいのね！\nそれじゃ、そっちの部屋に案内してあげる！:
Oh, you want that one!
Then I'll show you to that room!
strings.あ、そっちも可愛いですよね。\nお人形さんとかが付けてる靴っぽくて。\nあの悪魔:
Oh, those are cute too.
They look like boots a doll would wear.
That demon is cute all over.
It makes me want to go see it.
Don't you think so?
strings.あ、その子ですか……。\nうーん……どこがいいのか自分ではよくわかりません。\n:
Oh, that girl...
Hmm... I don't really get what's
so good about her myself.
She's not all that pretty...
And she's not particularly smart...
Hmm...
Thinking about myself
makes me kind of sad...
A-Anyway, thank you for answering.
I'll do my best, so watch me!
strings.あ、その方です。\n凄いですよね。\n自分も大変だと思うのに、\nちゃんと他の人:
Oh, that's her.
She's amazing, isn't she?
I'm sure she has it tough herself,
but she still tries to
look after other people...
I don't think I could do that...
strings.あ、その方です！\n凄く可愛いって評判なんですよね。\nずっと１度お話してみたい:
Oh, that's her!
She's famous for being really cute.
I've always wanted to talk
with her at least 1 time.
I wonder if I'd look good
dressed like that...
Hmm...
It seemed iffy, so I'll pass.
...That's a little sad.
strings.あ、それがヒノキなんですか？\n……これのお風呂？\n昔のトウキョウってすごい所:
Oh, so that's hinoki?
...A bath made of this?
The old Tokyo must have
been an amazing place...
...W-Well, anyway, I'll
give it to the owner later.
I learned something new.
Thank you so much!
strings.あ、それそれ！\nそれを１枚くれるなら入れてあげるよ！:
Ah, that's it, that's it!
If you give me 1 of
those, I'll let you in!
strings.あ、それって嘘だったんですか。\n私もちょっと怪しいと思ってたんですよね。\n女:
Oh, so that was a lie.
I thought it was a
little suspicious too.
A woman blindfolded in a tunnel...
It's obviously dangerous.
I figured there was no girl like that.
Thank you for telling me.
strings.あ、それはそうなんですけど……。\nでもお友達とかから何かを貰うのは凄く嬉しいん:
Oh, that's true, but...
I'm really happy to get
things from friends,
but don't you think it's scary
getting things from someone
you don't really know?
Like, you can't trust them.
So I really feel bad about it.
...I guess it's my fault for not
turning him down properly, isn't it?
strings.あ、それは私も思います。\n真面目そうでホント綺麗ですよね。\nうーん。\n私も:
Oh, I think so too.
She seems so earnest,
and she's really pretty.
Hmm.
I wish I could be prettier too...
strings.あ、それもいいですよね！\n無垢というか清潔な感じがしますよね。\n心が表れるよ:
Oh, those are nice too!
They feel innocent, or pure, don't they?
I like how they seem
to reveal your heart.
So you like flowers too, Devil Buster.
That makes me a little happy.
Thank you.
strings.あ、それカワイイわね。\nハムもきっとカワイイと思いそう。\nあ、ハムっていうの:
Oh, that's cute.
I bet Ham would think it's cute too.
Oh, Ham is this rabbit.
I named him Ham because he looks
tasty. Easy to remember, right?
strings.あ、それ凄いですね。\n山羊屋さんってお店を持ってるんですか。\nきっとデビルバ:
Oh, that's amazing.
So a Goat merchant owns a store.
I bet lots of Devil Busters go there.
I see.
So the unusual Goat merchant
is the one with a store.
I'll remember that.
Thank you.
strings.あ、そーだ。\nこの前誰かよくわからないヒトから、\n「悪魔スナック」ってのを貰:
Oh, right.
The other day someone I didn't know
gave me something called
a "Demon Snack"...
Is it okay to eat this?
strings.あ、ちなみに、お願いしたアイテムを\n拝見するだけで引き取ったりはしないんで。:
Oh, by the way, I'll
just look at the items
I asked for. I won't take them.
strings.あ、ちなみに、お願いした悪魔を\n拝見するだけで引き取ったりはしないんで、:
Oh, by the way, I'll
just look at the demons
I asked for. I won't take them,
strings.あ、ちなみにタケシといえば呪われキャラ！\nなーんて流れはもうありませんよ！:
Oh, by the way, the whole "Takeshi
is the cursed character!"
thing? That's over now!
strings.あ、ちょっと恥ずかしい質問をしてしまいましたね。\nゴメンなさい。\n夢は人に話:
Oh, that was a bit of an
embarrassing question.
I'm sorry.
Dreams aren't something
you tell people about.
Please take good care of the dream
in your heart and let it grow.
I'm rooting for you!
strings.あ、でも待機時間が回復するわけじゃ\nないから勘違いせぬようにな？:
Ah, but that doesn't mean the cooldown
recovers, so don't get
the wrong idea, you hear?
strings.あ、でも親御さんかも知れんから\nオッサンは失礼やね…。:
Oh, but he might be his parent,
so callin' him an "old guy" is rude...
strings.あ、どうでした？\nやっぱり今のトウキョウにヒノキなんてないんですかね？\nだと:
Oh, how did it go?
I guess there's no hinoki
in today's Tokyo after all?
If so, I asked you for
something really impossible.
I'm so sorry!
strings.あ、どうでした？\nやっぱり抽象的過ぎて分かりませんよね？\nゴメンなさい。今回:
Oh, how did it go?
I guess it was too vague
for you to figure out, huh?
I'm sorry. I'll give up on it this time.
I'm sorry for asking
something so unreasonable.
strings.あ、どうも久しぶりです！\nタケシですよ！:
Oh, hey, long time no see!
It's me, Takeshi!
strings.あ、どこかに行かれるんですか？\nデビルバスターさんですもんね。:
Oh, are you heading off somewhere?
You're a Devil Buster, after all.
strings.あ、どこかに行かれるんですか？\nデビルバスターですもんね。:
Oh, are you heading off somewhere?
You're a Devil Buster, after all.
strings.あ、なるほどー！\nだから皆さんは、\nその技術が上昇したとか話したりしてるんで:
Oh, I see!
So that's why everyone
talks about their skills going up.
Thank you for the
easy-to-understand explanation.
I learned something.
Thank you so much.
strings.あ、なるほど！\n確かにいつも燃えてる悪魔さんとかいますしね。\nそっか……そう:
Oh, I see!
There are demons that
are always on fire.
I see... that makes sense.
I understand now.
Thank you for telling me.
strings.あ、なんか聞いたことあるわ。\n彼が手塩にかけると、経験値の取得量が増えたりする:
Oh, I think I've heard of that.
When he raises them with care,
they gain more EXP or something?
That's amazing, and also
kind of scary in a way...
He should start something
like a demon nursery.
You leave them with him and he makes
them stronger on his own... like that.
strings.あ、なんでもない、なんでもない。\nまちがえたっぽい。:
Ah, never mind, never mind.
Guess I got it wrong.
strings.あ、ま、まだ話終わってないホ！: Ah, w-wait, I'm not done talking, ho!
strings.あ、ま、待てよッ！ 行くなよッッ！\nお、俺を置いて行かないでくれよォッ！:
Ah, w-wait! Don't go!!
D-don't leave me behind!
strings.あ、また繋がったね……。\n少しだけ君がいるトウキョウの事がわかって来た気がする:
Oh, we're connected again...
I feel like I'm starting to
understand your Tokyo a little.
I have a few more favors to ask...
Would you hear me out?
strings.あ、まだ見つかってないみたいですね。\nトパーズ……。\nどこかで見たんですよね:
Oh, it looks like you
haven't found it yet.
Topaz...
I know I've seen one somewhere.
Maybe you'd find one
somewhere like Suginami...
I'll look around too.
Um, if you don't mind, could you
keep looking a little longer?
I'm counting on you.
strings.あ、みんな帰っちゃったみたい。\nちゃんと連絡取り合いなさいよ！:
Oh, looks like everyone went home.
Keep in touch with
each other properly!
strings.あ、もう終わったの？\n早いな～。僕まだ残ってるのに…。:
Oh, you're done already?
That was fast~. I've
still got some left...
strings.あ、もしかして……。\n幸せに満ちた「カハク」ちゃんに会わせてくれるんですか！？:
Oh, could it be...
You're letting me meet the
"Kahaku" filled with happiness?!
...Th... thank you...
I'm so happy... really, so happy...
....
I'm sorry. I'm going
to go wash my face...
....
Oh, sorry to keep you waiting.
I was so happy, I just
couldn't hold it in.
I never thought you'd grant
such an impossible request...
...W-Well then...
Please let me meet the
"Kahaku" I asked for.
I've been dreaming of this forever!
....
Amazing! Truly amazing!
This "Kahaku" is amazing!
Meeting it, I understood clearly.
It's much, much sadder than me.
It's suffering far, far more than me.
And yet it keeps smiling.
Because if it smiles,
maybe someone else can be happy.
I bet that feeling
is what fills this "Kahaku"
with so much happiness.
I see.
If you smile from the
bottom of your heart,
it's bound to reach someone...
Thank you so much!
I'm so happy that words can't
express how grateful I am!
Someday, I'll let you hear my song.
I'll put all my gratitude into it.
When that time comes, please listen!
strings.あ、もしかして。\n今ニンゲンがしてる不思議な遊びの事？:
Oh, maybe you mean that weird game
the humans are playing right now?
strings.あ、もしかして「カハク」ちゃんと会わせてくれるんですか！？\n……うわぁ。ホント:
Oh, are you letting me meet a "Kahaku"?!
...Wow. I'm so happy.
I asked out of nowhere,
and you actually did it.
You're such a kind person!
Thank you! Thank you so much!
Then, just for a little while,
let me meet that "Kahaku," okay?
Is that all right?
....
Thank you.
I feel like I've grasped something...
The reason "Kahaku's" voice is so clear
is that it sings with the
wish that those who died
in the place it was born won't suffer...
That's why it's so full of
kindness, and so clear...
I could feel that so clearly...
If I gathered up all
the sadness inside me,
could my voice become like "Kahaku's"?
I think I'll give it
a try sometime soon.
Thank you for granting my wish!
strings.あ、もしかして持ってきてくださったんですか？\n……すごいですねー。\nホントに:
Oh, did you bring it for me?
...That's amazing.
The stone really is glowing...
Don't you wonder how it came to be?
...It really is a mysterious stone.
Thank you for something so precious!
strings.あ、もしかして首輪を探して来てくれたんですか？\nな、なんかすごいデザインですね:
Oh, did you find a collar for me?
W-Wow, that's quite a design...
But my friend likes this kind of thing,
so I'm sure they'll be happy with it.
Thank you so much!
strings.あ、もし私のお願いを聞いてくれたら\nもっとお渡ししても良いですけど……！:
Oh, and if you grant my favor,
I could give you even more...!
strings.あ、もちろん、インキュバスにも\n秘密にしてね！:
Oh, and of course, keep it
a secret from Incubus too!
strings.あ、もちろん沢山集まったら私のところで\n是非交換してくださいよ～？:
Oh, and of course, if
you collect a lot,
be sure to trade it with me~?
strings.あ、やけどね、その人の特徴は覚えとるけん\n捜せばどっかにおると思うっちゃん！:
Oh, but I remember what he looks like,
so if ya search, he's
gotta be somewhere!
strings.あ、やっぱり「ピクシー」ちゃんの中にも、\n顔が違ったり身長が違ったりとかあるん:
Oh, so even among "Pixies,"
some have different faces
or different heights?
In that case, do "Pixies"
also worry about
how to be cuter, just like me?
....
I suddenly feel a kinship with "Pixies."
I think we could be friends.
strings.あ、やっぱりすぐには見つかりませんよね？\n限界を突破できる薬……。\n売ったり:
Oh, I guess you can't find
it right away, can you?
Medicine that breaks your limits...
You can't sell it, so
maybe someone has some...
Why would my friend want
medicine like that?
...I'm sorry, but I'm counting on you.
strings.あ、やっぱりそういうものですよね。\nなんとなく大変そうなイメージはありましたけ:
Oh, I figured as much.
I kind of imagined it'd be tough,
but hearing you say it makes sense.
Fighting demons, exploring tunnels...
Being a Devil Buster
really is hard work.
Um... please don't push
yourself too hard.
strings.あ、やっぱりそういうものなんですか。\n凄く怖そうな悪魔さんとかはよくわかるんで:
Oh, so that's how it is.
I can understand that with
really scary-looking demons,
but are there also cute demons,
like little imps, that can't talk?
...I'm not even sure
what I'm saying anymore.
I'll calm down a bit.
I'm sorry...
strings.あ、やっぱりそういうダンジョンはあったんですね。\nやっぱり難しいですよね。\n:
Oh, so there really is
a dungeon like that.
It must be hard.
People have all different
traits, like being strong,
and things change depending on that...
I wonder how that works?
The world is full of mysteries.
strings.あ、やっぱりそうそう見つかりませんよね……。\nちょっと図々しいお願いでした。ゴ:
Oh, I guess they're not that
easy to find, are they...
That was a bit of a cheeky
request. I'm sorry.
If you find one, please let me know.
I'll be waiting...
strings.あ、やっぱりそうですよね。\n私もそんな場所ないんじゃないかなって思ってたんです:
Oh, I figured.
I didn't think a place
like that existed either.
Because sending demons
off to explore alone is,
how should I put it... cruel, isn't it?
I think Devil Busters should
go with them properly.
I'm glad to know the rumor was a lie.
Thank you.
strings.あ、やっぱりそうなんですか。\nあるデビルバスターさんから聞いた事があったんです:
Oh, so it's true.
I heard about it from a Devil Buster,
but everyone says it's dangerous,
so I couldn't go see it...

 solid "Ziotite".

I've prepared a thank-you gift, but...

strings.この匣を手に入れた実力を持つ\n君ならば、その力の主については:
You, with the ability

strings.この街のすぐ近くなんですけど……。\n人形みたいな形をした何かが、\nフワフワ浮:
Right near this town...
there's something shaped like a doll
floating around.
Do you know what that is?
strings.この街のどこかはわからないのですが、\nある乗り物の乗車券を売っている、\nそん:
I'm not sure where in this town,
but I heard someone sells tickets
for a certain vehicle...
Do you know what the tickets are for?
strings.この街のカジノで使える\nコインと交換してくれや。:
trade it to me for coins
you can use at this town's casino.
strings.この街のカジノで使える\nコインをくれてやる。:
coins you can use
at this town's casino.
strings.この街のコンピューターに届いたんだ。: It arrived at this town's computer.
strings.この街の中にいる方なんですけど。\nお酒を飲んで酔ってる人がいますよね？\nその:
There's someone in this town
who's always drunk, right?
That person...
What do you think they're drinking?
strings.この街の中央で咲いているお花、\n凄く綺麗ですよね。\nそう思いませんか？:
The flowers blooming in
the middle of this town
are really beautiful, aren't they?
Don't you think so?
strings.この街の事知らないね。: You don't know this town well, huh.
strings.この街の事良く分からないんだよね。:
I don't really know
much about this town.
strings.この街の人って……。\nなんていうのかな。\n元気な人ってあんまりいないですよね:
The people in this town...
How should I put it.
There aren't many lively
people, are there?
strings.この街の何処かなんですが……。\n有名な七人の賢者の一人から、\nメッセージが届:
Somewhere in this town...
I heard a message came from
one of the famous Seven Sages.
Did you know?
strings.この街の入り口に屋台があるでしょ？\nそこに古着屋さんがあるの。\nご存知かしら:
There are food stalls at the
entrance of this town, right?
There's a secondhand
clothing shop there.
Do you know it?
strings.この街の入り口に屋台があるでしょ？\nそこに変わったスナックを出すお店があるの。:
There are food stalls at the
entrance of this town, right?
There's one that sells unusual snacks.
Do you know it?
strings.この街の入り口に屋台があるでしょ？\nそこに変わったラーメンを出すお店があるの。:
There are food stalls at the
entrance of this town, right?
There's one that serves unusual ramen.
Do you know it?
strings.この街の入り口付近に、\n女性が一人立ってますよね？\nあの方……。\n誰かを探:
Near the entrance to this town,
there's a woman standing alone, right?
That woman...
She seems to be looking for someone...
Do you know anything about it?
strings.この街の入り口付近にいる、\nホントに綺麗な女性。\n実は可愛いお子さんがいるん:
You know that really beautiful woman
near the entrance of this town?
She actually has an adorable child.
Did you know that?
strings.この街の入り口付近にいる守衛さんて、\n昔何をなさってたかご存知ですか？:
Do you know what the guard
near this town's entrance used to do?
strings.この街の入り口付近にいる綺麗な女性。\n実は可愛いお子さんがいらっしゃるって、\:
You know the beautiful woman
near the entrance of this town?
Did you know she actually
has an adorable child?
strings.この街の外には、\n少し怖い人が沢山いるの……。\nもし外にでるのなら、\n十分:
Outside this town,
there are lots of somewhat
scary people......
If you go outside,
please be very careful......
Do you understand?
strings.この街の外の話なんですけど。\n時々白いふわふわした何かが、\n浮かんでますよね:
This is about outside of town.
Sometimes there's
something white and fluffy
floating around, right?
Do you know what that is?
strings.この街の真ん中にいる……。\n雪だるまのぬいぐるみって、\n変わった口調で話しま:
The stuffed snowman
in the middle of this town...
talks in a funny way, doesn't it?
Do you know what it says?
strings.この街の真ん中に何本か木があります。\n実は……。\n季節とかで装飾が変わる、\:
There are a few trees in
the middle of this town.
Actually...
the decorations on them
change with the seasons.
Did you know that?
It makes you want to look
at them again and again...
strings.この街の角にあるんですけど……。\n紫の絵が浮かんだりしてる、\n物々しい入り口:
There's a building at the
corner of this town...
With a purple picture
floating in the air
and a really imposing entrance.
Do you know what that building is?
strings.この街の雰囲気って、\nあなた達から見るとどんな印象なのかしらね。\n確かに住み:
What impression does
this town's atmosphere give you all?
It's certainly easy to live in, but
it's basically a human town, so for
someone like me... it's a bit, you know.
strings.この街へ来た理由は……。\n……第三ホームでの生活が苦しくなったの。\n父が体調:
The reason I came to this town...
...life in Home III had become hard.
My father fell ill...
Around then, some people from
this town came to Home III.
We heard all sorts of things from them,
and the whole family came here...
Now my father's health
has recovered somewhat,
but he can't push himself to work.
So I...
strings.この街をでてすぐの所にも「ピクシー」ちゃんさんとか、\n羽が生えてる悪魔さんはい:
Right outside this town,
there are demons with wings
like "Pixie" and such.
But this is about arms that ARE wings...
Hmm... I can't really picture
it, so I'd like to see it.
What kind of person could she be?
If you get the chance to
see her, please tell me.
strings.この街をでて左側に行ったところかな？\nそこにすごく大きい悪魔さんがでるって、\:
If you leave this town
and go left, I think...
I heard a really huge demon
appears there...
Do you know what demon it is?
strings.この街を出て、\nすぐのところに人がいますよね。\nその方が連れてる悪魔さんって:
Right outside this town,
there's someone standing, right?
The demon that person has with them...
What was it called again?
strings.この街を出てしばらく行った所に、\n野営地があるって聞いたんですけど……。\nな:
I heard there's a campsite
a little ways out from this town...
Do you know what that
campsite is called?
strings.この街以外はマッカしか使わない。: Outside this town, they only use Macca.
strings.この裏バベルには、\n「扉」がいくつかあるんだホ。:
There are several "doors"
here in Hidden Babel, ho.
strings.この複雑な「乙女心」。アナタなら\nきっとわかってくれると思うんだ！:
This complicated "maiden's
heart"... I'm sure
you'll understand it!
strings.この言葉に従う事で、\nあなたの元へ幸せが訪れることでしょう。:
By following these words,
happiness will surely come to you.
strings.この調子で、さらに強い妖魔たちが\n進入してる『上級ロジックスペース』の:
Keep it up and go clean out
"Advanced Logic Space",
where even stronger Lucifer
Hawks have invaded -
strings.この調子でもっと集めるぞ！\n頼んだぞ！:
Let's keep this up and gather more!
I'm countin' on ya!
strings.この調子で次は\n【 ＤＯＯＲ－０２ 】にいってみるホ！:
Keep it up and try
[ DOOR-02 ] next, ho!
strings.この調査は一旦打ち切る。\n必要以上の深追いはアホのすることだ。:
We'll call off this
investigation for now.
Pursuing it further than
needed is for idiots.
strings.この辺りと近い雰囲気の場所なのかしら。\nトウキョウの破壊って本当に広域なのね…:
Maybe it has a similar
feel to this area.
The destruction of Tokyo
really was widespread, huh...
strings.この辺りは危険な場所みたい。\n気をつけてね。:
This area seems to be dangerous.
Be careful.
strings.この辺りは大破壊の影響も少ないし…。:
This area wasn't hit as hard
by the Great Destruction...
strings.この迷える子羊にぃぃぃぃ！\n正義の鉄槌をぉぉぉぉ！:
Upon this lost lambbbbb!
The hammer of justiceeeee!
strings.この遣いは、\n私達への警鐘？:
Is this messenger
a warning bell for us?
strings.この部屋におる悪魔研究士に聞いておくれ。: ask the Demon Researcher in this room.
strings.この部屋の宝箱は取得済みだ。:
The treasure chest in this
room has already been taken.
strings.この部屋は猛毒が充満しているようだ。:
This room seems to be
filled with deadly poison.
strings.この鍵はクソボロ故に、一度使うと\nぶっ壊れるから、念のため確認するけど、:
This key's a crappy piece
of junk, so it'll break
after one use. I'm
asking just in case, but
strings.この鍵はクソボロ故に、一度使うと\nぶっ壊れるから、念のため確認するけど、\n本:
This key's a crappy piece
of junk, so it'll break
after one use. I'm
asking just in case, but
you really going, ho?
strings.この閉じた世界で\n俺とマザーハーロットは戦い続ける。:
In this closed world,
Mother Harlot and I
will keep fighting.
strings.この間……。\n友達の持っている宝石が、\nちょっとひび割れてしまったのです。\:
The other day...
a gem my friend owns
got a little cracked.
Do you know any good way to fix it?
strings.この間……。\n小さい男の子から飴玉を貰ったんです。\n食べてみたら凄く美味しく:
The other day...
a little boy gave me a piece of candy.
It was so delicious...
I said thank you and
rubbed my cheek against
his without thinking.
strings.この階層の主『アリス』の\n強さは、この裏バベルでも群を抜いてるホ！:
The strength of this
layer's master "Alice"
stands out even in Hidden Babel, ho!
strings.この階層の主『セト』の\n強さは、この裏バベルでも群を抜いてるホ！:
The strength of this
layer's master "Seth"
stands out even in Hidden Babel, ho!
strings.この階層の主『マザーハーロット』の\n強さは、この裏バベルでも群を抜いてるホ！:
The strength of this layer's
master "Mother Harlot"
stands out even in Hidden Babel, ho!
strings.この階層の主『マーラ』（ご立派な方）の\n強さは、この裏バベルでも群を抜いてるホ:
The strength of this layer's master
"Mara" (the Magnificent One)
stands out even in Hidden Babel, ho!
strings.この階層の主『メタトロン』の\n強さは、この裏バベルでも群を抜いてるホ！:
The strength of this
layer's master "Metatron"
stands out even in Hidden Babel, ho!
strings.この階層の全てのフラグをリセットして、\n敵を出現させますか？:
Reset all flags on this layer
and spawn enemies?
strings.この際、手当たりしだい乗り込んで\nシコタマ叩いてやるんだホ！:
While we're at it, charge
into whatever you can
and give 'em a real pounding, ho!
strings.この際ニンゲンに実際に\nやってもらおうという事になったのだ。:
so we decided to have actual
humans do one for us.
strings.この霊園には、\n酒を愛する性質の悪い死神がいる。:
In this cemetery, there's a nasty
Reaper who loves sake.
strings.この霊園に居たいと欲する理由が\nオマエにはアルのか？:
Do you have a reason for wanting
to be in this cemetery?
strings.この霊園に足を踏み入れた者のようだな…。:
You seem to be one who has set foot
in this cemetery...
strings.この香りは…ランダの香り…。\nキミと話す事は何もないよ。:
This scent... it's Rangda's scent...
I have nothing to say to you.
strings.この魂を虜にするかのような\nまばゆい魅惑の発色…。もしや…。:
This dazzling, alluring
color that seems
to captivate the
soul... Could it be...
strings.この魔階、この地に封じられた意味が\n顕されているのではないかい？:
isn't the meaning of this
dungeon, of what was
sealed in this land, being revealed?
strings.この魔階においては、この輝きについて\n気に留めておいて損はないよ。:
In this dungeon, it doesn't hurt
to keep this radiance in mind.
strings.この魔階には、スイッチとそのギミックが\n多くあることは知っていたけど、:
I knew this dungeon had lots of
switches and gimmicks, but
strings.この魔階はスザクが出ると聞き及びます。:
I've heard that Suzaku
appears in this dungeon.
strings.この２つのプログラムを破壊し\n下らぬ制限を解除するものであるぞ。:
It destroys these 2 programs
and lifts their petty restrictions.
strings.この３種があれば、間違いなく特殊な\n隠しロックの方を解除できるはずっパ！:
With these 3 kinds, we
should definitely be able
to undo the special hidden lock-pa!
strings.この４点のいずれかを持っていないと、:
If you don't have one
of these 4 items,
strings.このＤＥの効果対象は\nパートナー用しか存在しておらぬ。:
This DE's effect target
only exists for partners.
strings.このＰＣ…。\n持ち主が現れたら、当然、返さなきゃいけないよな。\n\n\nどう:
This PC...
If the owner shows up, I've
gotta give it back, obviously.


Seems like the only way I can connect
with you is through this thing.
Which means...
Without it, we...
...
Well, I guess that
can't be helped either.
Anyway, let's talk again
when you feel like it.
strings.このＰＣの持ち主…。\n困ってねえかな？:
The owner of this PC...
I wonder if they're in trouble?
strings.こやつについて、\n未だよくよく情報を把握しておらぬのじゃ。:
I still don't have a good grasp
of information about this one.
strings.こやつらは、お主のような「初心者」の\nために特別に用意した悪魔じゃ。:
These are demons
specially prepared for
"beginners" like you.
strings.こらー！\nそんなんだからダメなんだよー！\nもうちょっとシャキっとしないと！\:
Hey!
That's why you're no good!
You gotta shape up!
No slacking off!
Got it?
strings.これ、お役に立つかどうかわかりませんが、\n受け取ってください。:
I don't know if this will be useful,
but please take it.
strings.これ、くれるの？\n…ありがとう！\n本当にもらっちゃっていいの？:
You're giving me this?
...Thank you!
Are you sure I can really have it?
strings.これ、くれるの？\n…ありがとう！ 欲しかったんだこれ。\n本当にもらっちゃって:
You're giving me this?
...Thank you! I've wanted this.
Are you sure I can really have it?
strings.これ、くれるの？\nありがとう！ うれしいな。\nとってもおいしそう。大事に食べ:
You're giving me this?
Thank you! I'm so happy.
It looks delicious. I'll savor it.
strings.これ、どこで見つけたっパ？！\nどこにあったんだっパ～～！！:
Where did you find this-pa?!
Where was it-pa~~!!
strings.これ、アレですよねアレ！\nレッツチャレンジ！！:
This is, you know, THAT thing!
Let's challenge!!
strings.これ、プレゼント…？\nありがとう！ それ欲しい…うーん。\nでも悪いから受け取:
Is this a present...?
Thank you! I want it... hmm.
But I'd feel bad, so I can't
accept it. Thank you, though.
strings.これ、プレゼント…？\nごめんなさい、それあんまり欲しくないかも。:
Is this a present...?
Sorry, I don't think I really want that.
strings.これ、私にですか……？\n…\nえーと… いただく理由がよくわからないのですけど:
This is... for me...?
...
Um... I'm not really sure
why I'd be getting this...
strings.これ、私にですか……？\n…\nお気持ちだけ受け取っておきます。\nご自身の為に:
This is... for me...?
...
The thought alone is enough.
Please keep it for yourself.
strings.これからおやつの時間なの…。\nまたあとで来て…？:
It's about to be snack time...
Could you come back later...?
strings.これからちょっと難しくなるよー。:
It's gonna get a little
hard from here, okay?
strings.これからは、\n私もアナタに報いましょう。:
From now on,
I too shall repay you.
strings.これからは、お前がお前で\nあり続けるための戦いだ。:
From here on, it's a fight for you
to keep being who you are.
strings.これからはあたしが、\n今回培った経験をあなたに分けてあげる！:
From now on, I'll share the experience
I gained this time with you!
strings.これからは好きなように使ってチョーダイ。: Use it however you like from now on.
strings.これからも、神のため\nそしてそれに従う民のために:
From now on, for God,
and for the people who follow Him,
strings.これからも、神の下僕として\nこの私に仕えなさい。いいですね？:
From now on, serve me
as a servant of God.
Understood?
strings.これからも、造物主に仕え\nそして従うのであれば……。:
If you will continue to serve
and obey the Creator......
strings.これからも『山羊屋・朱雀洞店』の\n平和をよろしくお願い致します！！:
Please continue to keep the peace
of "Goat Shop: Zhu
Que Cavern Branch"!!
strings.これからもっともっと頑張らないと。:
You'll need to work
even harder from here.
strings.これからもデビルバスターとして\n任務に励んでくれ。:
Keep working hard on your
missions as a Devil Buster.
strings.これからもドンドン集めて\nドンドン持ってきてくれっパ～！:
Keep on collecting more and more
and bringing them to me-pa~!
strings.これからもワシの為に\n働いて欲しいホ！:
Keep working for me
from now on-ho!
strings.これからも仲魔と力をあわせていくんだぞ。:
Keep working together with
your demons from here on.
strings.これからも宜しくお願いしますね！:
I look forward to our
continued friendship!
strings.これからも精進するんじゃぞ。\n深淵からの生還者よ。:
Keep up your training.
Survivor of the Abyss.
strings.これからも精進するんじゃぞ。\n王佐の才よ。:
Keep up your training.
Born Advisor.
strings.これからも精進するんじゃぞ。\n異界の覇者よ。:
Keep up your training.
Ruler of the Netherworld.
strings.これからサタンに近づくほど、\nさらに強力な悪魔が出るだろう。:
The closer we get to Satan,
the stronger the demons will be.
strings.これからパーティーが始まるの。\n一緒に行ってくれるでしょ？:
The party's about to start.
You'll come with me, right?
strings.これから喧嘩でもするの？: Are you about to get into a fight?
strings.これから寝る。: I'm about to go to sleep.
strings.これから悪魔の叫びを\n捧げ続ければ……。:
If we keep offering
demon cries from now on...
strings.これから私達が成すべき事を、\n説明いたしましょう。:
Let me explain what we
must do now.
strings.これから言う２つの内容を達成してみろ！:
Accomplish the 2 things
I'm about to tell you!
strings.これから言う３つの条件をクリアしろ。:
Clear the 3 conditions
I'm about to tell you.
strings.これから頼むぜぇぇぇ\n相棒ぅぅぅぅぅ！:
I'm counting on you from now onnnn,
partnerrrrrr!
strings.これが、私が知る限りの内容だ。\nま、事の真相も分からんがな。:
That's all I know about it.
Not that I know the
truth of the matter.
strings.これがあれば、元来火炎に弱い\n仲魔の弱点を補ったり、:
With it, you can cover
the weakness of a demon
naturally weak to Fire,
strings.これがあれば、妾はいつまでも\n美しくあり続けられようぞ。:
With this, I can remain
beautiful forever.
strings.これがいつまで続くかはわからないから、\nあの世界にいくなら今のうちかもね。:
I don't know how long this will last,
so if you're going to that
world, now might be the time.
strings.これがなかなかどうして先へは\n進ませてもらえない。:
It just won't let me get
any further ahead.
strings.これがカッパの技術力っパー！:
This is the power of
kappa technology-pa!
strings.これがゲームに参加してる人の証に\nなるんだ。:
This'll be your proof that
you're taking part in the game.
strings.これがデータ集めの一助となることを\n期待しておるぞ。:
I hope this will help you
in your data collection.
strings.これが一体なんなのか？\nまだ解明はされておらんのじゃ。:
what exactly is it?
That still hasn't been figured out.
strings.これが一番難しいところ。\nコツは相手に興味を持つことだ！:
This is the hardest part.
The trick is to take an
interest in the other person!
strings.これが事実だとすれば\n悠長に構えていられまい。:
If this is true,
we can't afford to sit idle.
strings.これが噂の『サーヴァントフォックス』と\nいうものですか。:
So this is the rumored
"Servant Fox".
strings.これが欲しいなら『百合の徽章』が\n１５０００個程必要になる。:
If you want this, you'll need
about 15000 "Lily Emblem".
strings.これが正しい課題だった。\nハッハッハ、間違えて済まなかった！:
This is the correct assignment.
Ha ha ha, sorry for the mistake!
strings.これが正しき道とは限りませんが、\n真理が歪められるのを阻止してください。:
This may not be the
right path, but please
prevent the truth
from being distorted.
strings.これが無いと悪魔と戦えませんから…。: I can't fight demons without it...
strings.これが無ければ、\nどうしてやることも出来ん。:
Without it,
there is nothing I can do.
strings.これが行える仲魔は『御魂合体』を\n行った仲魔のみ。:
Only demons that have undergone
"Mitama Fusion" can do this.
strings.これこそが、我の本質。\n我に相応しき栄華。:
This is my true essence.
The glory that befits me.
strings.これこそが「ＤＭプロジェクト」の\n全貌であり、要諦だ。:
That is the whole picture and
the essence of the "DM Project."
strings.これじゃあまるで俺がマヌケじゃないか！\nちくしょうが！:
This makes me look like a total idiot!
Dammit!
strings.これだけあれば、\nご褒美もらえニャくても……、:
With this many, even if I don't
get a reward...
strings.これだけあれば、\nバアル様に会う事もできよう。:
With this much,
I should be able to meet Lord Baal.
strings.これだけあれば、\n魔人になるヒントも見つかるはず！:
With this many, I'm sure to find

strings.どうやらドウマンが、\nタマゴを割っちゃったみたい。:
Looks like Douman
went and cracked the Egg.

those with grudges against White Day.

it seeems it's connected

It seems whoever made it
had some really twisted intentions,

My theory is gradually
turning into certainty!
Yes... it seems you're not
from the world we live in.
You're from a created world...
the world of Megami Tensei.
I don't know how it works...

or whether the fictional world
of Megami Tensei began
interfering with the real world.
Wow, this world really
is full of unknowns!!
Don't you think it's wonderful?

It seems you have the minimum strength

Looks like its effect has worn off.

It seems you don't have room
to carry a summoning device.

It seems to be some kind
of earthbound spirit...

in the same spot...
strings.どうやら奴らは『パイ投げ合戦』を\n開催しているようだホ！:
Looks like those guys are
holding "Pie-Throwing Battle"-ho!
strings.どうやら小娘は助かったようだね……。\n良かったじゃあないか。:
Seems the little girl was saved...
Good for you, eh?
strings.どうやら悪魔探しのために\n私のところに来たようだけど、:
It seems you came to me
looking for demons, but

It seems the place you can reach
depends on the direction you toss it.
strings.どうやら持ちきれないようですね。\n整理したらもう一度話しかけてください。:
Looks like you can't carry it all.
Sort things out and talk to me again.
strings.どうやら持ち物がいっぱいのようだね。\n空きを作ってくれれば渡してあげよう。:
Looks like your inventory is full.
Make some room and
I'll give it to you.
strings.どうやら持ち物に\n余裕がないみたいですねぇ。:
It seems you don't have
room in your inventory.

It seems you don't have
room in your inventory.

It seems there have been
no new victims.

It seems there have been no

new victims, then.

and it seems enemies drop it

Looks like you're
carrying too much stuff?

It seems you lack the
qualifications to set out

death. Come back later.

It seems the nuisances have been

it seems they are trying to bring down
something barbaric.

Looks like there's no mistake.
This should be no problem.

How 'bout it? If you
bring me 5 fragments
and "Aramitama",

Well?
Did you get all that?

What do you say?
Want to try my quest?

but there are lots of unusual
facilities here, right?

here from somewhere,
and people who've been through
truly terrifying things.

but it's not like I can
erase their memories...

to help frightened people
recover even a little sooner.
But even if it's something small,
won't you work at it with me?

You may come across the
mysterious Alice somewhere.

You might use it somewhere.

has appeared somewhere.

I should have a yukata somewhere!
What should we start with first...

You ask some god somewhere
to come, right?

I heard it's a space made

Someone somewhere

Someone somewhere
might want it, right?
...Go on, hurry up and go!

It seems something some idiot
brought down has appeared.

You sense Barong's presence
somewhere nearby...
strings.どこか近くでランダの気配がする……:
You sense Rangda's presence
somewhere nearby...

Someone like you might get attacked
just for going near it.
I heard it's in "Ichigaya,"
so why not go there?

Where's that...
I'm telling you, I don't
know any shop like that.
strings.どこでその事を知ったの？: Where did you hear about that?

I can't remember where we met.
Could it be...
strings.どこで入手できるかは\n自分で探してくれ。:
Find out for yourself
where to obtain it.
strings.どことなく雰囲気が似てますよね。:
She kind of gives off
a similar vibe to you.
strings.どこにあるか、だって？\nアハハッ。:
Where are they, you ask?
Ahaha.
strings.どこにあるかは、知らないけども。: I don't know where it is, though.

Where are theyyyy!
Are you saying I can't seeeee them!?

Nobody's sure where it is, either.

start by looking into that.
strings.どこに住んでるんだっけ？: Where did you say you live?
strings.どこに行きたいっパ？: Where do you want to go-pa?

Where ya wanna fly to?
Safe! Secure! And
speed! That's my motto!
strings.どこの進入権が欲しいの？: Where do you want entry rights for?
strings.どこまでも一緒ぉぉぉ\n略して、どこいつぅぅぅ！:
Together everywhere foreverrrr,
or "TEF" for shorttttt!
strings.どこまで行けるかを挑戦するような\n気持でやるのが良いじゃろう。:
it's best to approach
it as a challenge
to see how far you can get.
strings.どちらかが死に絶えるまで続く。: It'll go on till one side is wiped out.

Looks like we have to
pick one or the other-pa.
Which will you choose-pa?

Either way, it's not something you
normally see in Tokyo.
strings.どちらのアイテムと交換しますか？: Which item would you like to exchange?

Which plug-in or item
do you have with you?
strings.どちらの悪魔も外見について\nイロイロな説があるせいかもしれんのう。:
Perhaps because there
are many theories
about what both of them look like.
strings.どちらの悪魔を\nお見せいただけますでしょうか？:
Which demon could
you show me?
strings.どちらの素敵なアイテムが欲しいんだホ？: Which lovely item do you want-ho?
strings.どちらの言葉にも受け取れる……。: It could be taken either way......
strings.どちらも『おかしなお菓子』２５０個との\n交換ですが、どうしますかー？:
Both are in exchange for
250 "Strange Sweets".
What will you do?
strings.どちらも『ラピッド』からは\n外れてしまうけれど、:
Both stray a little
from "Rapid", but

You can do both
by going to "Nakano
Underground Ruins".

There may be conditions for both,
so be careful.

basically only the
Mitama Reunion portion
is converted into points for either.

Go break your money somewhere
and come back.

I must've dropped 'em somewhere.
...Wait, were ya lookin' for me?
strings.どっかのシンガーソングライターが作る歌みたいな名前をしてるチームだな。\n比較的:

He should know which side
his bread's buttered on.

Which is it...

strings.どっちも歩いていけるんだぜ？:
you can walk to either

L-l-look at the map
carefully as you w-walk.

The, special, items, obtained,
do, not, differ, by, difficulty.

I don't know the details

told to give it to
whoever holds this hand.

I don't know the details
of what it is, but I was
told to give it to whoever
holds this feather.

I don't know the details
of what it is, but I was
told never to defy whoever holds it.

Which event field ya wanna fly to?

the ultimate "Yes!"!!!

Which Epitaph Part
don't you need anymore?

strings.どのエリアに移動しますか？: Which area will you move to?
strings.どのクスリをグイっといきたいのじゃ？\nもちろん対価はもらうがの。:
Which medicine do you want to chug?
I'll be taking payment, of course.
strings.どのサポートが欲しいっパ？: What kind of support do you want-pa?
strings.どのダンジョンに飛びたいんや？\nこれが、天下無敵の力だぁぁァァ！！:
Which dungeon ya wanna fly to?
This is the power of the invincible!!!
strings.どのテストを受けたい？: Which test would you like to take?
strings.どのフィールドに飛びたいんや？\n最速で突っ走ってなにが悪い！:
Which field ya wanna fly to?
What's wrong with
going full throttle!?

Whose quest-ho?
Watch your inventory
and COMP space-ho!

Which job request

I won't stop you,
whatever I say, ho...

Which job request will you take, ho?
If you give up, the game's
over right there, ho!
strings.どの小種族を増やしたい？:
Which sub-race do you
want to increase?
strings.どの小種族を減らしたい？:
Which sub-race do you
want to decrease?
strings.どの小部屋に転送する？: Which small room shall I send you to?
strings.どの町に飛びたいんや？\n突き進む！！ 、徹底的にな！:
Which town ya wanna fly to?
Charge ahead!! All the way!
strings.どの種族の悪魔全書メモリを\nご所望かな？:
Which race's Compendium Memory
do you desire?
strings.どの街に行くんだホ？: Which town are you going to-ho?
strings.どの難易度の稽古を望むか？:
What difficulty of
training do you seek?
strings.どの難易度を選びますか？: so which difficulty will you choose?
strings.どの難易度を選びますか？\n（『溶けたチョコ』所持数：<ItCount:2159:
Which difficulty will you choose?
("Melted Chocolate"
held: <ItCount:21591>)
strings.どの魔階についてお話しましょーか？: Which dungeon shall we talk about?
strings.どれ、\nうまい花見酒のため働くとしようか！:
Well then,
let's get to work for some
fine blossom-viewing sake!
strings.どれ、うまい花見酒のため働くとしようか！\nそれそれ！ 血を献じてゆくが良い！:
Well then, let's get to work for
some fine blossom-viewing sake!
Come now, come now!
Offer up your blood!
strings.どれ、ちょっと貸してみろィ。\nそうだな。:
Here, lend it to me a sec.
Let's see.
strings.どれ、不要なものを見せてみるがよい。 \n少しはマシなものと引き換えてやろう。:
Now, show me what you don't need.
I'll trade you something
a little better for it.
strings.どれ、今日は何用なのじゃ？\n申すがいい。:
Now, what brings you here today?
Speak up.
strings.どれか一体だけで構わん。\n御魂合体を施し、連れてくるのじゃ。:
Just one of them is fine.
Perform a Mitama fusion
on it and bring it here.
strings.どれか仕事片付けてから\nまた来ちゃってん。:
Clear up one of 'em
and come back again.
strings.どれくらいの強さかと言うと、\n荒ぶる砂漠の神をも倒せる方をですわ。:
How strong, you ask? Someone who can
defeat even the raging
god of the desert.
strings.どれと交換するの？: What do you want to trade for?
strings.どれと交換する？: What do you want to trade for?
strings.どれも気に入らない…。\n君は、新しい勢力ということかな。\nこれは面白くなてき:
You don't like any of them...
So you're a new faction, then.
Things are getting interesting.
Ah, no, never mind me.
strings.どれ程のものか。試させてもらおう。: Let me test you, and see how much.

Here! Lend it to me.
With my heart of fire, I
shall reveal its true form.

It's a place you keep
diving deeper into.
strings.どんなお客さんだったの？: What kind of customer was it?
strings.どんなスイカも\n豆腐のように柔らかに粉砕ですっ！:
It'll smash any watermelon
as easily as soft tofu!

strings.どんな事をするのかというのが\n話題になったのだ。: and what is done at one.
strings.どんな危険な場所でも、『山羊屋』チェーン\n&#10;をよろしくお願いいたします:
No matter how dangerous
the place, please

keep choosing the
"Goat Shop" chain!

What kind of cheering

I'm really curious what

and an invincible Devil

he charges in alone
against any opponent at all.
strings.どんな窮地も退かない精神:
A spirit that never
retreats from any pinch

Whatever obstacles come my way,
I'll never give up!

There's one thing I really gotta ask.

In the Ikebukuro where you are.

Quit moping 'cause you're not popular,
give it a look - it'll
change your world!
strings.どーだったの？\nあたしはちょっと苦手なんだー。\n言ってる事がむずかしーんだよ:
How was it?

so hard to understand.

Were you okay?

Howdy.

strings.どーもコンニチワ！\nバイト商人のハヅキよ！:
Hiya, hello!
I'm Hazuki, the part-time merchant!
strings.どーやら逃げ遅れたコもいるみたいだね～。\nフビン～。:
Looks like some folks
didn't get out in time~.

Wh...
Don't tell me Sugamo Prison is
going to appear in Ikebukuro...!!

Wh...!!
Is that your thing...? You want
to strip me...? And you care more
about the clothes than me...?
I want to punch you for
all sorts of reasons...!

I'll intimidate you!

Wh-What are you... talking about!

strings.な、な、なんなんだよ！ お前ェ！！\n何でここであえて怖い話するんだよォ！:

story HERE of all places!
strings.な、なぁ…\nあんた…。\n俺のことが好きか？:
H-Hey...

do you like me?

H-Hey...

Do you think I could
become a Devil Buster too?

Th-that's quite a hardcore way

strings.な、なにをニヤけている！\nあ、あっちへ行け！:
Wh-what are you grinning at!
G-go away!
strings.な、なに？\nそんなに見られてても困るわ…よ…。:
Wh-What?
It's awkward when you stare like that...
strings.な、なに？\nそんなに見られてても困るんだけど…！:
Wh-What?

strings.まぁキミもヒマしてたら、\n遊んでいってよ。:
Well, if you're bored too,
hang out for a while.
strings.まぁツクヨミなんですけど、\nそれでいいホ？:
Well, it's gonna be Tsukuyomi,
is that okay-ho?
strings.まぁヒノカグツチなんですけど、\nそれでいいホ？:
Well, it's gonna be Hinokagutsuchi,
is that okay-ho?
strings.まぁファフニールなんですけど、\nそれでいいホ？:
Well, it's gonna be Fafnir,
is that okay-ho?
strings.まぁブラザーが心配だから\n来てみたって事だホ。:
anyway, I was worried about brother,
so I came to check, ho.
strings.まぁボクはいつも\nゆらゆらしてるんだけどね。:
Well, I'm always
bobbing around anyway.
strings.まぁヤマタノオロチなんですけど、\nそれでいいホ？:
Well, it's gonna be Yamata no Orochi,
is that okay-ho?
strings.まぁ一角だし、獣だものね。そのまんまね。\nそうすると私って二角人て呼ばれるのか:
Well, it has one horn and
it's a beast. That's literal.
Then would I be called
a two-horned person?
H-How uncool...
strings.まぁ君はもう、\n例の石はもう持っているようだ。:
Well, it seems you already
have that stone.
strings.まぁ品定めは他にもイロイロと。:
Well, I size up all sorts
of other things, too.
strings.まぁ奴のことだ、\n１人でいるとは思えんがな。:
Well, knowing him,
I doubt he's there by 1self.
strings.まぁ対策は色々と立てられると思うホ。\n気張って倒すホ。:
Well, I think you can come up
with all kinds of strategies, ho.
Put your back into it and beat it, ho.
strings.まぁ敵って言っても、\nお年玉みてぇなのをザクザク拾えるから、:
Well, even if they're
enemies, you get to
scoop up loads of that
gift-money stuff,
strings.まぁ新人という存在はＤＢに限ったもの\nじゃないけどね。:
Well, newcomers aren't limited
to DBs, though.
strings.まぁ時間に余裕があったら探してみても\nいいかもね。:
Well, if you have time to spare,
it might be worth looking for them.
strings.まぁ肝心のチョコが\n無いのだけれど……。:
Well, I don't actually have
any chocolate, though...
strings.まぁ良い、食してみるとしよう。: Oh well, let's give it a taste.
strings.まぁ詳しくは、中にいる\nお猿さんから聞いてね。:
Anyway, for details, ask
the monkey inside.
strings.まぁ貴重な物だろうし、: Well, it's probably a valuable thing,
strings.まぁ貴重な物だろうし、\nしょうがないよな。:
Well, it's probably a valuable thing,
so I guess it can't be helped.
strings.まぁ！ 闇夜に挿す光のように\nなんと素敵な男性なの！:
My! Like a light
piercing the dark night,
what a lovely gentleman!
strings.まあ…。\nそういう反応になってしまうよな。:
Well...
I guess that'd be the reaction.
strings.まあ…。\n普通に考えたらそうなるよな。:
Well...
if you think about it
normally, that's how it'd be.
strings.まあ…。\n褒め言葉と受け取っておくことにする…。:
Well...
I'll take that as a compliment...
strings.まあ…知り合いだな。\nいずれ、紹介できるかもな。:
Well... someone I know.
Maybe I can introduce you someday.
strings.まあ、いいだろう。\n今回はこれで良しとしよう。:
Well, all right.
We'll call this good for this time.
strings.まあ、そう思うのなら\n関わらん方がいい。:
Well, if that's how you feel,
better not to get involved.
strings.まあ、そう思うのなら仕方がない。:
Well, if that's how you
feel, it can't be helped.
strings.まあ、そう思うのなら仕方がない。\n……じゃあな。:
Well, if that's how you
feel, it can't be helped.
...See ya.
strings.まあ、それじゃあ\n連れては行けないな。:
Well, then I can't
take you.
strings.まあ、まずはアレと話をしてみるといいわ。\nもしダメなら、:
well, first try talking to her.
If that doesn't work,
strings.まあ、また何かほしくなったら\n声かけてよ！:
Well, if you want something later,
just give me a shout!
strings.まあ、バイトなんだけどさ。: Well, it's a part-time job, though.
strings.まあ、何と言うか…。\n子供たちのちょっとした喧嘩…の様なものだ。\nうん…大事:
Well, how should I put it...
It was like... a little
squabble between kids.
Yeah... I hope it doesn't
turn into something big...
strings.まあ、無理に答えてもらう必要はないけどね。:
Well, you don't have to
answer if you don't want to.
strings.まあ、私はそういうのは平気な方だけど。\n警察沙汰は困るからな…。:
Well, I'm the type who's
fine with that stuff.
But trouble with the
police is a problem...
strings.まあ、興味が無いなら\n関わらん方がいい。:
Well, if you're not interested,
better not to get involved.
strings.まあ、避暑地っていっても\nのんびりできるところではないから:
Well, even though it's a cool retreat,
it's not a place where
you can relax, so
strings.まあいいや、ありがとうね！\nまた何かあったらお願いね！:
Oh well, thanks!
If anything comes up again,
I'll be counting on you!
strings.まあよい。\n今は気分がいいからな！:
Well, whatever.
I'm in a good mood right now!
strings.まあ当然の理じゃな。こういうのを\nうぃんうぃんの関係というらしいぞよ。:
Well, naturally. I hear
this sort of thing
is called a "win-win" relationship.
strings.まあ私なら５秒もいらんがな。\nハッハッハ！:
Well, I wouldn't even need 5 seconds.
Ha ha ha!
strings.まあ～、第二ホームを調査したい時は\nまた声をかけてよ～。:
Well~, whenever you
want to investigate
Home II, just talk to me again~.
strings.まいどぉぉお、うまいどぉぉぉ\nぼく外道ぉぉぉぉぉぉぉォぉォッッ！:
Thaaank youuu, yummy yummmyyy
I'm a scoundrellll!
strings.まえにお兄ちゃんが\n強いって言ったけど、:
I told you before that my
big brother's strong, but
strings.まこと、お主の働きは\n賞賛に価する。:
Truly, your work
is worthy of praise.
strings.まこと、素晴らしい働きと力を見せ、\n我の想いに応えてくれたことに:
Truly, for showing
splendid work and power,
and for answering my wishes,
strings.まさか、\nここでいたずらを仕掛けられるとは……。:
To think I'd have a prank
pulled on me here...
strings.まさか、また俺の頼みを聞いてくれる\nというわけでもあるまい！:
Surely you don't mean you'll
take on my request again!
strings.まさか、本当に持ってくるとは驚いた。\n大変じゃなかったか？:
I'm surprised you actually brought it.
Wasn't it tough?
strings.まさかあいつを倒すとは……。\nおまえの力は俺の想像以上だな……。:
To think you'd actually
beat that guy...
Your power is beyond
what I imagined...
strings.まさかそんなに大きい相手だったとは\nさすがのオイラも気づかなかったホ！:
Even I didn't realize the enemy
was THAT huge, ho!
strings.まさか俺まで、\nボコボコにするつもりか…？:
Don't tell me you're planning
to beat me to a pulp too...?
strings.まさか本当に集めてくるとは\n思わなかったホ。:
I never thought you'd actually
collect them all, ho.
strings.まさか本当にＬＮＣ変動するとは\n思わなかったですか？:
You didn't think your LNC
would actually shift?
strings.まさか砂が動いて人を襲ったと？:
You're saying sand moved
and attacked people?
strings.まさか貴様からその名前を聞こうとはな。:
so I never thought I'd
hear that name from you.
strings.まさか銃で撃たれて生きてると思うかい？\nやっぱり…悪魔用の武器が必要だね。:
You think he'd survive
getting shot with a gun?
I really do need a weapon for demons.
strings.まさか食べたっちゃなかろうね…\n悪いけど、持ってきてくれん？:
Don't tell me ya ate it...
Sorry, but could ya bring it to me?
strings.まさにデビルバスターのお手本の様な\n存在だったぞ。:
He was a true model of
what a Devil Buster should be.
strings.まさに初心者冥利、\n初心者愛の勝利。:
Truly the joy of a beginner,
the triumph of beginner love.
strings.まさに悪魔だけの世界。: Truly a world for demons only.
strings.まさに戦う天使。その盾であまねく攻撃を防ぎ\nその槍で、敵対する者を貫きます。:
Truly a fighting angel. With that
shield he blocks every attack,
and with that spear he
pierces those who oppose him.
strings.まさに近接・物理を支配する者の力ね。\n私も欲しいのだけど、悪魔と契約すれば手に:
Truly the power of one who
rules melee and the physical.
I want it too. Could I get it if
I made a pact with a demon...?
strings.ましてや人の身で成し遂げるのは\nもしやすると不可能なことかもしれません。:
And for a mere human to accomplish it
may well be impossible.
strings.まじかよ…。\nなんて場所なんだ…。:
Seriously...?
What kind of place is that...
strings.まじめに答えたらダメねぇ。\nちょっとからかうくらいが楽しいわ…。:
Answering seriously is no good.
Teasing a little is much more fun...
strings.まず、わしのラボは、\nお主にとってデジタライズの修練場じゃ。:
First, my lab is your
Digitalize training ground.
strings.まず、デジタライズするには\n召喚時と同様のマグネタイトが必要じゃ。:
First, Digitalizing requires
the same Magnetite as summoning.
strings.まず、デジタライズできる仲魔は\n御魂合体が施された悪魔のみじゃ。:
First, the only demons
that can be Digitalized
are those that have
undergone Mitama fusion.
strings.まず「エキスパート」って知ってる？:
First of all, do you know
what an "Expert" is?
strings.まずある程度、片付けてから来やがれ！:
Clear some of it out
first, then come back!
strings.まずこの『メタトロン』の特性として、\n四大天使を召喚するってことは話したホ。:
First off, I told you that
one of "Metatron"'s traits
is summoning the Four Archangels, ho.
strings.まずね～\nここから結構遠い場所で会ったっちゃんね。:
First off~
I met him somewhere
pretty far from here.
strings.まずね～\nずーっと何かを待っとらしたよ。:
First off~
He was waitin' for
somethin' the whole time.
strings.まずね～\nウチが見かけた場所はスギナミ！:
First off~
The place I saw him was Suginami!
strings.まずね～\nウチが見かけた場所は新宿バベル！:
First off~
The place I saw him
was Shinjuku Babel!
strings.まずね～\nパンキッシュな首輪が特徴的やった！:
First off~
He had this real punkish collar!
strings.まずね～\n温厚そうな人やったよ。:
First off~
He seemed like a gentle person.
strings.まずね～\n青白い色した装置の近くだった！:
First off~
It was near this pale blue device!
strings.まずは、\n変換ポイントを使用したい:
First, select the RANK of
the growth type
strings.まずは、もう少し力をつけてきてね。: First, go get a bit stronger.
strings.まずは、わしのラボで修行するといい。\nデジタライズポイントは、:
First, you should train in my lab.
Digitalize Points
strings.まずは、エピタフパーツと呼ばれる媒介を\n造り出すため、『体験の香』が必要じゃ。:
First, to create the medium called
an Epitaph Part, you'll
need "Trial Incense".
strings.まずはあなたから\n岩の下にでも封じ込めましょう。:
I'll start by sealing you
under a rock.
strings.まずはこっちからアクション起こして\n向こうに知ってもらわねーと:
If I don't make a move first
and get her to know me,
strings.まずはご報告があるそうです。: It seems there's a report first.
strings.まずはそういう人が居るか捜すのも\n良いかもしれないわねぇ～。:
so looking for people like that first
might be a good idea~
strings.まずはそちらにいる、モー・ショボーの話を\n聞いてきてはいただけませんか？:
First, would you go and hear what
the Mou-Shoubo over there has to say?
strings.まずはイチガヤの悪魔を殲滅し、\n深追いせずに撤退するぞ。:
First we'll wipe out
the demons in Ichigaya,
then withdraw without
pressing too far.
strings.まずはイージーにいこう。私が指定する\nアイテムを自らの手で集めてくるんだ。:
Let's start easy. Gather the items
I specify with your own hands.
strings.まずはティターニアさんと、\nカグラザカに向かってね！:
First, head to Kagurazaka
with Titania!
strings.まずは仲魔を召喚しておくれ。\nそれから診てやろう。:
First, summon your demon.
Then I'll take a look at it.
strings.まずは使ってみることじゃ。\n扱い方は、わしが教えよう。:
First, just try using it.
I'll teach you how to handle it.
strings.まずは基礎だよ。 \n魔法で攻撃する威力に関しては、:
First, the basics.
As for the power of magic attacks,
strings.まずは奴に会って、\n話を聞いてみてくれないか。:
but first, would you go meet him
and hear what he has to say?
strings.まずは彼女のもとへ行って、\n情報を得てください。:
First, go to her
and get some information.
strings.まずは扉【 ＤＯＯＲ－０１ 】の先へ\n潜入、制圧するんだホ！:
First, sneak in beyond door
[ DOOR-01 ] and conquer it, ho!
strings.まずは扉の場所を地図で\n確かめるんだホ！:
First, check where the doors
are on the map, ho!
strings.まずは生き返らしてやるのじゃ。\nそしたら診てやろう。:
First, revive it.
Then I'll take a look at it.
strings.まずは自分の職分を全うしたらどうだい。: Why not fulfill your own duties first?
strings.まずは荷物を整理するんだね。: First, go sort out your bags.
strings.まずインキュバスを呼び寄せる為に、\n魔階とかで『魔除けの牛乳』を集めろ。:
First, to lure out Incubus,
collect "Protective Milk"
in the dungeons and such.
strings.まずセト神の肉体を復活させるため\nドウマンの秘術を頼りました。:
First, to revive the god Seth's body,
I relied on Douman's secret arts.
strings.まず先に『御魂合体』の注意点を話そう。\nお主に注意点の説明は不要かな？:
First, let me tell you the
precautions for "Mitama Fusion".
Or do you not need them explained?
strings.まず初めに『マハスクンダ』を習得させた\n『シキガミ』を連れてきてくださいっ。:
First, please bring me "Shikigami"
that has learned "Mahasukunda".
strings.まず媒介として、『リユニオン搾取器』\nなるものが必要じゃ。:
First, as a medium, you need
something called "Reunion Extractor".
strings.また、あの昂りの中の、\n楽しき時間を味わいたくてな。:
I'd like to savor a delightful time
in that exhilaration again.
strings.また、あの昂りを、\n我に味わわせてくれないか。:
Won't you let me taste
that exhilaration again?
strings.また、おまえノやくわりヲはたしたら、\nおれノところニきてください。:
when YOU fulfill your ROLE again,
please COME to me.
strings.また、お前か！\n今日は一体何の用だ？:
You again!
What do you want today?
strings.また、ここに戻りたい時は、\nここに来た時と同じ様に大穴に入るがよい。:
If you want to come back here,
enter the big hole the
same way you did before.
strings.また、こちらの抜け道を使用した場合、\nお持ちのＣＯＭＰに影響が出てしまいます。:
Also, using this passage will affect
the COMP you carry.
strings.また、このモードでは、弱点相性の\n異なる敵が、稀に紛れております。:
Also, in this mode,
enemies with different
weaknesses are occasionally mixed in.
strings.また、すぐそういうこと言う…。\n前に強くぶつけた事があるけど、全然取れる感じは:
There you go again...
I bumped them hard once, but they didn't
feel like they'd come off at all.
It's my head, so if I pulled hard and...
they slid out... that'd be scary, right?
Heh heh heh...
Well, maybe one day they'll
just pop off like deer antlers.
strings.また、そのスキルは詠唱に８秒もかかるから\nその間に逃げればいいんだホ。:
Also, that skill takes
8 seconds to cast,
so you can just run away
in the meantime, ho.
strings.また、その気になることがあれば、\nまた我に話しかけてくれ。:
If you ever feel like it again,
talk to me once more.
strings.また、もしもあなたが『イケブクロ』で\n秘術を聞いていた場合に使える、:
Also, if you've heard the
secret arts in "Ikebukuro",
strings.また、わたくしに会いに来て下さい。\nウフフ。:
Please come see me again.
Ufufu.
strings.また、アイテムが集まったら\n持って来てくださいね！:
When you collect more items,
bring them to me!
strings.また、イチガヤに向かうには全員が\n『コアシールド』を持っている必要がある。:
Also, to head to Ichigaya, everyone
needs to have "Core Shield".
strings.また、ドウマンほどの呪術師であれば\n贄たる資格もあろうかと思いましたが:
I also thought a sorcerer
of Douman's caliber
might be qualified to
be the sacrifice, but
strings.また、パーティを組んで大勢で行くのも\n良いかも知れません。:
Also, it may be good to form
a party and go as a large group.
strings.また、プレゼントを用意しておきますよ。:
I'll have another
present ready for you.
strings.また、他の仲間が既に&#10;\n私から術を授かっていた場合、\n貴様に授ける意:
Also, if another of
your companions

has already received a means from me,
there is little point
in granting it to you.
strings.また、仲魔を鍛えたいなら\n俺様に話しかけるといい。:
If you want to train
your demons again,
talk to me.
strings.また、共に歩んでいこうとする存在もまた\n必要であるのでしょう。:
who watch over them warmly
and try to walk alongside them.
strings.また、召喚中の仲魔にも、\n報酬の経験値獲得量が適用されます。:
The EXP reward also applies
to your summoned demons.
strings.また、召喚者を強化する特徴も\n当然ながら適用される。:
And of course, traits that strengthen
the summoner also apply.
strings.また、呼び出す、悪魔の、難易度が、\n設定できます。:
You, can, also, set, the, difficulty,
of, the, summoned, demon.
strings.また、大きな事件を解決したら\nお話を聞かせてくださいねー。:
Once you've solved
another big incident,
please come tell me about it.
strings.また、悪魔の中には御魂合体という\n特殊な合体を行った悪魔がおる。:
Also, among demons
there are those created
by a special fusion
called Mitama fusion.
strings.また、暫しの間、\n補助をさせていただく証としまして、:
Also, as proof that I will be
supporting you for a while,
strings.また、曜日によっても変化します。:
They also change depending
on the day of the week.
strings.また、気が向いたら\n会いにきてくれると嬉しいです！:
If you feel like it, I'd be happy
if you came to see me again!
strings.また、滅多には無いことだが、&#10;\n貴重な品を落とす。:
Also, though it's rare,

they drop precious items.
strings.また、滅多には無いことだが、&#10;\n貴重な品を落とすそうだ。:
Also, though it's rare,

they're said to drop precious items.
strings.また、翌日になるまで\n他の者から召喚器を貰えなくなります。:
Also, you will not be able to
receive a summoning device
from the others until the next day.
strings.また、翌日になるまで\n他の者から召喚器を貰えなくなります。\nそれでも構いませ:
Also, you will not be able to
receive a summoning device
from the others until the next day.
Is that acceptable?
strings.また、近接には基本的に３つの攻撃相性が\n存在する。:
Also, melee basically has 3
attack affinities.
strings.また、ＤＬｖが上がることで、\n異世界の悪魔へ与えるダメージが増加する。:
Also, as your DLv
rises, the damage you
deal to the other world's
demons increases.
strings.また『パイ投げ合戦会場』に入場したら、\nアンタの頭上に数字が現れるホ。:
Also, when you enter
"Pie Fight Arena",
a number will appear
above your head-ho.
strings.また『理の砂』を生成するには、\n十数時間は必要じゃ。:
To generate "Sand of Reason" again
will take well over ten hours.
strings.また『鬼面トマト』を集めて、ビーチを盛り上げましょう。:
Gather "Demon-Face Tomato"
again to liven up the beach.
strings.また『魔力の結晶』が集まりましたら、\nお持ちください。:
When you gather more "Magic Crystal",
please bring them.
strings.またいい感じに溜まったね！\nまたチョコを渡してくるよ！:
It's piled up nicely again!
I'll go give out chocolate again!
strings.またお会い出来て感激の極みです！\nお元気でしたか？:
I'm overjoyed to see you again!
Have you been well?
strings.またお前か……。\n今日もお前の世界には悪魔がいるだの言うのか？\n……いいだろ:
You again...
Are you going to tell me there are
demons in your world again today?
...Fine.
If you want to prove that
what you're saying is true,
do what I'm about to tell you.
Got it?
strings.またお前なのか……。\n俺も暇じゃないんだがな……。\nだが少しは息抜きも必要だ:
You again...?
I'm not exactly idle, you know...
But I suppose a little
breather is necessary.
Fine.
I'll humor your talk about

strings.ん？ …あー、アイツから聞いたのか。\nしょーがねぇなあ。:
Hm? ...Ah, you heard it from him, huh?
Geez, what a pain.
strings.ん？ あの子達の本命チョコは\nいらないのかって？:
Hm? Don't I want those girls'
true-love chocolates?
strings.ん？ いつまでここにいるのだ？\n妾を見捨てて、何処へなりと行くが良いさ。:
Hm? How long will you stay here?
Abandon me and go wherever you please.
strings.ん？ すまん……\n今、何か言ったかね？:
Hm? Sorry......
did you say something just now?
strings.ん？ どうしたの…？\n何か言いたそうな顔をして。:
Hm? What's wrong...?
You look like you want to say something.
strings.ん？ オメェなかなか修羅場を潜ってきた\n顔をしているな。:
Hm? You've got the face of someone
who's been through some real hell.
strings.ん？ 三国志の話？: Hm? Is this about Three Kingdoms?
strings.ん？ 何…？ 急にそんなにじろじろ角を眺めて…。\n無礼にもほどがあるバカチンだ:
Hm? What...? Suddenly staring
at my horns like that...
You're a dummy with no manners at all...
strings.ん？ 何…？ 急にそんなにじろじろ角を眺めて…。\n無礼にもほどがあるバカチンね:
Hm? What...? Suddenly staring
at my horns like that...
You're a dummy with no manners at all...
strings.ん？ 何か聞きたいのか？: Hm? Got something you wanna ask?
strings.ん？ 俺に渡し物？\nおっ！ チョコレートか！:
Hm? Something for me?
Oh! Chocolate!
strings.ん？ 受けている仕事が\n多すぎやせんか？:
Hm? Haven't you taken on
too many jobs?
strings.ん？ 受けている仕事が\n多すぎるぞ！:
Hm? You've taken on
too many jobs!
strings.ん？ 周りを見渡してどうした…の？: Hm? Why are you looking around...?
strings.ん？ 回収したメノラーの数を\n聞きたいだと…。しょーがねぇなあ。:
Hm? You wanna know how many Menorahs
you've collected...? Fine, fine.
strings.ん？ 待たれよ。\n其方、多くの事を抱え過ぎではないか？:
Hm? Wait.
Aren't you taking on too many things?
strings.ん？ 貴様、良いツラ構えをしているな。: Hm? You've got a good look about you.
strings.ん？おお『理の砂』か、忘れとったわ。\nほれ、今までの協力、感謝するぞい。:
Hm? Oh, "Sand of
Reason", I'd forgotten.
Here, thanks for all your help so far.
strings.ん～…他の特徴といえば\nオシャレなゴーグルしとったかも。:
Mm~... As for other features,
I think he wore stylish goggles.
strings.ん～…他の特徴といえば、\n……服の色は薄かったかも……？:
Mm~... As for other features,
...his clothes were
light-colored, maybe...?
strings.ん～…他の特徴といえば、\nオシャレなゴーグルしとったかも。:
Mm~... As for other features,
I think he wore stylish goggles.
strings.ん～…他の特徴といえば、\n年齢はウチよりちょっと上かも。:
Mm~... As for other features,
he might be a little older than me.
strings.ん～…他の特徴といえば、\n白い肌に真っ青な色をした瞳やったかも。:
Mm~... As for other features,
maybe fair skin and deep blue eyes.
strings.ん～…他の特徴といえば、\n肌の色が赤かったかも。:
Mm~... As for other features,
I think his skin was red.
strings.ん～…他の特徴といえば、\n６つ子さんやったんかなぁ？:
Mm~... As for other features,
maybe they were 6-tuplets?
strings.ん～、そうじゃな。なんかアンニュイな\nオーラを出した普通のおっさんじゃ。:
Hmm, let's see. He's an
ordinary middle-aged guy
giving off a kind of listless aura.
strings.ん～？\nデジタライズしてないみたいだよ～。:
Hmm~?
Looks like you're not Digitalized~.
strings.アア！ あなたは！ 僕です、タケシです！\nアマツチ久しぶりです！:
Ahh! It's you! It's me, Takeshi!
Long time no see, by heaven and earth!
strings.アイツ、傷つきやすい性格だから\nオイラが守ってやらないといけないホ！:
He's the sensitive type,
so I've gotta protect him, ho!
strings.アイツが売ってる詩…\nなんか妙な味わい深さがあるよな。:
The poems she sells... they've got
some weird kind of depth, don't they?
strings.アイツが荒らぶってる時なんかは、\nよくコイツを渡して、:
Whenever she was on a rampage,
I'd often give her this
strings.アイツと話したらわかるかと思うけど\nちょっと夢見がちな１６歳なんだ。:
You'll probably get it
once you talk to him,
but he's a bit of a
dreamy 16-year-old.
strings.アイツのおかげで\n散々な目にあわされたぜ…。:
That guy put me
through the wringer...
strings.アイツのおかげで散々だったな。\nお互いに…。:
He sure put us through the wringer.
Both of us...
strings.アイツは真面目にやれば\nちゃんと頑張れるヤツだホ。:
If he takes it seriously,
he's a guy who can
really work hard-ho.

strings.スギナミ…恐ろしい場所なのね…。\nというか、その土地の紹介としてその返答も\n:

to the area, that answer
is pretty silly. It's funny.

strings.スギナミに……「ケットシー」って、\nそんな悪魔さんがいるじゃないですか？\nあ:

called "Cait Sith," right?
Its hat is so cute.
I'd like to try it on once...
What do you think?
strings.スギナミのとある悪魔を訪ねましょう。: Visit a certain demon in Suginami.
