OF DEMON YOU SUMMON NOW.
strings.今回、鎮圧が一段落した為、\n久しくこのバベルに帰還したのだ。:
Now that the suppression
has settled down,
I've returned to Babel for
the first time in a while.
strings.今回だけよ？\nここから先は自分で頑張りなさい。:
Just this once, OK?
From here on, do your
best on your own.
strings.今回のカミサマを降ろす遊びの期間は\n<AggregationPeriod>まで:
This round of the god-summoning game
lasts until <AggregationPeriod>.
strings.今回のバイトは歩合制なんだから、: This part-time job pays on commission,
strings.今回のヤマは～♪\n湿気がいっぱい～っパ～ パっパー♪:
This job here~♪
Is full of humidity~ pa~ pa-paa♪
strings.今回の件は、\nワシが独断で動いておる。:
In this matter,
I'm acting on my own.
strings.今回の戦いの結果だが……: As for the result of this match...
strings.今回の雪合戦を得点にするならば、\nアンタは【%d】点だホ！:
If I scored this snowball fight,
you'd get [%d] points, ho!
strings.今回は、より強い力で拒み、\nアナタを排除しようとするでしょう。:
This time, she will
reject you with greater
force and try to eliminate you.
strings.今回は『ツリーオーナメント』が\n手に入らないけど、戻る？:
You won't get "Tree
Ornament" this time.
Still want to go back?
strings.今回は『天突』悪魔の件のみ\nよろしく頼むとするが、:
This time I'll just ask you
to handle the "Tentotsu" demon matter,
strings.今回はここまでにしよう。\nもとの場所に戻るか？:
Let's call it a day.
Want to go back to where you were?
strings.今回はこれくらいにしておこう。\n無駄に体力を使いたくないんだ。:
Let's leave it at this for now.
I don't want to waste my stamina.
strings.今回は初めてだから\n特別にオマケをつけるっパ！:
Since this is your first time,
I'll throw in a special bonus-pa!
strings.今回は本当に世話になったの。\nまた何かあれば声をかけるがいい。:
You've really done a
lot for us this time.
If anything comes up, call on me.
strings.今回は特に何かを販売しているわけでは\nありません。:
This time I'm not selling
anything in particular.
strings.今回は特別に、条件達成という事に\nさせていただきましょう！:
Just this once, we'll count it
as meeting the condition!
strings.今回は相方のハヅキと二手に分かれて\n行商してます！:
This time my partner Hazuki and I
split up to do our peddling!
strings.今回は秋赤音さんの宣伝協力兼、\nイベント協力ということで、:
This time, as part of
promoting Akane Aki
and helping out with the event,
strings.今回は通常の魔階に異変がないかと、\n異世界の魔階の調査がしたいんだ。:
This time I want to check the
normal dungeon for anomalies
and investigate the
otherworld dungeon.
strings.今回は魔王自らが貴方を招聘したために、\n魔界へ行くことが出来たようですね。:
this time it seems you
could go to the Demon Realm
because the Demon King
himself invited you.
strings.今回ばかりは褒めてやるよ。\nやるじゃねーか！:
this time I'll give you credit.
Not bad at all!
strings.今回もお前に、\nプレゼントを用意してあります。:
This time too,
I've prepared a present for you.
strings.今回もまた、非常に強い力で拒み、\nアナタを排除しようとするでしょう。:
This time too, he will
reject you with very
great force and try to eliminate you.
strings.今回も相方のハヅキと二手に分かれて\n行動中です。:
This time too, my partner Hazuki and I
have split up to work.
strings.今回得られた硬さに関するデータを応用し、\n硬さを誇る妖鬼の悪魔が:
Applying the data on
hardness obtained this time,
I've made an Enhancement
Plugin that turns a Brute
strings.今宵も鼻の穴を\nふくらませざるを得ない！:
Tonight, too, I can't help
flaring my nostrils!
strings.今年もハロウィンイベントをやろうかと\n思ったけど、:
I was thinking of doing
a Halloween event
this year too, but
strings.今年も来たわね。\nこの季節が！:
It's come again this year.
This season!
strings.今年も相棒と戦場を\n駆け抜ける毎日であった。:
This year too, I spent every day
racing across the
battlefield with my partner.
strings.今年も良いバレンタイン日和だわねぇ。:
It's fine Valentine's
weather again this year.
strings.今年も街はハートで彩ってますね！\n毎年恒例、愛の行商に来ました！:
The town's decorated with
hearts again this year!
I've come for my annual love peddling!
strings.今年も街はハートで彩ってるわね。\nハッ！ おめでたいことだわ！:
The town's decorated with
hearts again this year.
Hah! How very festive!
strings.今度、第三ホーム帰ったら、ウチが何か\n料理してみるけん、味見係に付き合ってよ。:
Next time I'm back at
Home III, I'll try
cookin' somethin', so
be my taste tester.
strings.今度かわいい悪魔を連れてきてあげるホ！:
Next time I'll bring
you a cute demon-ho!
strings.今度こそウチがすれ違った人の\n特徴ば思い出したけん、聞いちゃってん！:
This time I really
remembered what the guy
I passed looked like, so hear me out!
strings.今度なくしたら、ハルマゲドンを\nお見舞いするホ！:
If you lose it again, I'll treat you
to Armageddon, ho!
strings.今度は、 \n霊験灼かな毛糸使って縫い直すけん、:
This time I'll sew it
with miraculous yarn,
strings.今度はもーっと驚かせるように\n頑張ってね♪:
Next time, try your best
to surprise them even mooore♪
strings.今度はウエノにハンドベルを使う\n悪魔がいるという情報を手に入れたホ！:
This time I got word there's a demon
who uses handbells in Ueno, ho!
strings.今度はワイルドな男が\nいいかなー……。:
Maybe a wild guy
this time...
strings.今度はワタシにプレゼントしてくれても\nいいんだよ？:
Next time, you could
give ME a present, you know?
strings.今度プレゼントしてあげるよ。: I'll give you some next time.
strings.今後、アナタの望みに応じて、\nブラックマリア様の元へ、お送りします。:
From now on, I shall send
you to Lady Black Maria
whenever you wish.
strings.今後ともヨロシク。: I'll be in your care from now on.
strings.今後とも出来るだけ協力し合いましょう。:
Let us cooperate as much
as possible from here on.
strings.今後とも真・女神転生ＩＭＡＧＩＮＥを\nよろしくお願い致します。:
We hope you'll continue to enjoy
Shin Megami Tensei IMAGINE.
strings.今後のためにもおまえもクランに\n入ってみたらどうだ？:
For the future, why don't you
try joining a clan too?
strings.今後の参考の為に、キミの\n『パイ投げの記憶』を見せておくれ。:
For future reference, show me
your "Memories of Pie Throwing".
strings.今後の研究の為に\nわしが引き取ってやるぞ。:
I'll take it off your hands
for future research.
strings.今後はオレの状況も\nアナトに知らせてやってくれ。:
From now on, let Anat know
how I'm doing too.
strings.今後はコイツに、『ヘナの実』だけでなく、\nオレの状況も知らせるようにしよう。:
From now on, I'll have them tell you
not only about "Henna Fruit"
but also how I'm doing.
strings.今後も、開発・運営に努めてまいります。:
and we will keep working hard
on development and operation.
strings.今後もお前に任せるような仕事があれば\n宜しく頼む。:
If there's work I can leave
to you in the future,
I'll be counting on you.
strings.今後も仕事は一緒にしていくわ。\n恋人になることは絶対にないけど。:
We'll keep working
together from here on.
Though we'll never, ever be a couple.
strings.今後も新しい悪魔を誘い込むために、\nみんなには秘密にしてね。:
Please keep this secret from everyone,
so we can keep luring in new demons.
strings.今持ってる仕事をこなしてから、\nまたおいで。:
Finish the jobs you have now,
then come back.
strings.今挙げたダンジョンに居る悪魔達を\nコテンパンにしてやっちゃってください！:
Give the demons in the dungeons I just
listed a good thrashing!
strings.今日…今日はこの際ハッキリさせておきたいんだが！\nお、お前は女神転生の世界の住:
Today... Today I want to get
this settled once and for all!
Y-You're from the world of
Megami Tensei, aren't you!!
strings.今日のあなたの金運は\n福の神さえもうらやむ大強運…:
Your money luck today is so strong
that even the god of
fortune would be jealous...
strings.今日のあなたは、\n向かう所敵なしの無双状態…:
Today, you are unstoppable,
with no enemy wherever you go...
strings.今日のあなたは、勝利の女神に祝福された\nグッドステータス状態です…:
Today, you are in a Good Status,
blessed by the goddess of victory...
strings.今日のあなたは、頑張れば頑張るほど\n悪目立ちをすることになりそう…:
Today, it seems the harder you try,
the more you'll stand out
for the wrong reasons...
strings.今日のご用件は、\n例の件についてですね！？:
Today you're here about
that thing, right!?
strings.今日のご用件は、例の件についてですか？: Is today's business about that matter?
strings.今日のところは\nまだ一度もその姿を見ておりません。:
So far today,
I haven't seen it even once.
strings.今日の仕事運は\nそれほどでもないでしょう…:
Your work luck today
is probably nothing special...
strings.今日の分はもうお渡ししましたよー？: I already gave you today's, you know?
strings.今日の恋愛運は\nそれほどでもないでしょう…:
Your love luck today
is probably nothing special...
strings.今日の日常が、明日も続くとは限らない。\nワシも君も、他人事ではない。:
There's no guarantee today's normal
life will continue tomorrow.
That's not someone else's
problem, for me or for you.
strings.今日の目玉は５０万マッカで叩き売る\n超特売タリスマン『くまのぬいぐるみ』と:
Today's highlight is the super
bargain talisman "Teddy Bear",
dumped at 500,000 Macca, and
strings.今日の金運は\nあまり芳しくなさそうですね…:
Your money luck today
doesn't look very good...
strings.今日の金運は\nそれほどでもないでしょう…:
Your money luck today
is probably nothing special...
strings.今日は、某亀が住んでる苔むした\n地下の遺跡らしき場所っぽいですよ！:
Today, it seems to be a mossy
underground ruin where
a certain turtle lives!
strings.今日は、水晶がキラキラまぶしい\n洞窟らしき場所っぽいですよ！:
Today, it seems to be a cave
with dazzling, sparkling crystals!
strings.今日は、豪華で綺麗な内装の\nたかーい塔らしき場所っぽいですよ！:
Today, it seems to be
a really tall tower
with a lavish, beautiful interior!
strings.今日は『牢獄の鍵』を\nいっぱい持ってきたホー！:
Today I brought
a whole bunch of "Prison Key", hee-ho!
strings.今日はあなたに\n頼みたい話があったのですが……:
There was something I wanted
to ask of you today, but......
strings.今日はありがとう。\n結構、面白い話を聞けて楽しかったわ。\nまた気が向いたら来:
Thanks for today.
I enjoyed hearing some
pretty interesting stories.
Come again whenever you feel like it.
If either of us gets something
interesting, let's trade, okay?
strings.今日はここまでにしよう。\nもとの場所に戻るか？:
Let's call it a day.
Want to go back to where you were?
strings.今日はこれ以上の頼みをするつもりはない！\n早々に立ち去るがいいわ！:
I have no intention of making
any more requests today!
You'd best clear out right away!
strings.今日はどうする？\nまたあの場所に送ってやろうか？:
What'll it be today?
Want me to send you
to that place again?
strings.今日はどちらで、\n我を楽しませてくれるのだ？:
Which will you entertain
me with today?
strings.今日はなんだか、\nいてもおかしくないような気配だけ、:
Today, somehow, I'm sensing
just the faintest feeling
strings.今日はまた…。\n随分と物騒なものをぶら下げているね？:
Today you're...
carrying around something
pretty dangerous, aren't you?
strings.今日はもうシンクロニシティエッグを\n貰っているようね。:
Looks like you've already gotten
a Synchronicity Egg today.
strings.今日はもう出ません。: Nothing more is coming out today.
strings.今日はもう貰ったみたいだ～。: Looks like you already got one today~.
strings.今日はクイズに挑戦してくれて\nありがとうございます！:
Thank you for taking
our quiz today!
strings.今日は何とか社会って所の人から\n商品を仕入れてきたんだけどさ:
Today I stocked up on
goods from someone
at some kind of Society place,
strings.今日は変な裁縫職人の女から\n商品を仕入れてきたんだけどさ:
Today I stocked up on goods
from this weird seamstress lady,
strings.今日もホントに幸せでした！\n私、ずっとずっと待ってます！\nあなたが来てくれる:
I was so happy again today!
I'll be waiting, forever and ever!
I'll always be waiting for you to come!
strings.今日も何か言ってたよ。: It was saying something today too.
strings.今日も来てくれてありがとうございます！\nまた来てくださいね！ 待ってますから！:
Thank you for coming again today!
Please come again! I'll be waiting!
strings.今日も来て下さってありがとうございました！\nまた来てくださいね！:
Thank you for coming again today!
Please come back again!
strings.今日も楽しい時間をありがとうございます！\n良ければまた来てくださいね！:
Thank you for another fun time today!
If you'd like, please come back again!
strings.今日頼めることはなくなってしもうた。\nまたあれば、お願いしようかのう。:
I've run out of things to ask today.
If more come up, I'll ask you then.
strings.今日？\nんー……。\n何にしようかしら？\nお花を買いに行くつもりだから、\n:
Today?
Hmm...
What should I have?
I'm planning to go buy flowers,
so maybe I'll have ramen nearby?
What about you?
strings.今渡してあるVer.1.0が不具合無く動くか\nどうかの確認期間も含め:
Including a period to
check whether the Ver.1.0
I gave you works without any bugs,
strings.今異世界の悪魔の\nデータが欲しいんだ。:
Right now I want
data on otherworld demons.
strings.今行っているお仕事を終わらせてから\nまた来てください！:
Please finish the jobs you have now
and then come again!
strings.今行っている悪魔全書の改良では:
In the improvements
I'm working on now,
strings.今設置するのは無理だ。\n他のをオーダーしてくれるか？:
I can't set one up now.
Wanna order something else?
strings.今話した３種類を集めて来て\n俺様によこしな。:
Collect the 3 kinds I
just told you about
and hand them over to me.
strings.今読み返してみると、何つーか\nすごく気持ち悪いっつーか。:
but readin' 'em again now, they're,
like, super creepy, y'know?
strings.仕事がいっぱいのようだな。: Seems you have a lot of jobs.
strings.仕事が一段落して\nきゃつが戻ってきたら、:
Once the work settles down
and the guy comes back,
strings.仕事が多いみたいだな。\n今頼んでも能率がいいとは思えない。:
Looks like you've got a lot of work.
I doubt you'd be very
efficient if I asked now.
strings.仕事が生き甲斐なもので。: Work is what I live for.
strings.仕事が空いたら、ワシのところに\nくるがよい。:
When you have time free,
come see me.
strings.仕事だからなぁ……。そんなにだよ。: It's my job... so not really.
strings.仕事だろうが、プライベートだろうが\n構わずに看破する:
Whether at work or in private,
you'll see right through everything,
strings.仕事といえば仕事だけど、\nここが家みたいなものだから毎日が休みとも言えるからな:
It's work, in a way,
but this is like my home, so you
could say every day's a day off...
I'm the one who asked, but this
is pretty hard to answer......
Hmm, in times like these, you can't
draw a line between work and rest...
strings.仕事にならないので弱りました……。:
I'm at a loss, since I can't
get any work done......
strings.仕事に燃える山羊屋がいた。:
There was a Goat merchant
who's fired up about work.
strings.仕事の整理ができたら、\nまた話しかけてほしい。:
Once you've sorted out your jobs,
speak to me again.
strings.仕事は３つは空けてくるのが基本だぜ！\n依頼を受けたきゃいつでも言ってくれ。:
Rule of thumb is to keep
at least 3 job slot open!
If you wanna take the
request, just say the word.
strings.仕事をこなして、\n一人前になってから、また試してね。:
Do some jobs, become a full-fledged
Buster, and then try it again.
strings.仕事を減らしたら、また来てくれないかな。:
Once you've cut down on
jobs, come see me again.
strings.仕事を減らしてから、また来て頂戴。: Cut down on your jobs and come back.
strings.仕事を片付けたら、\nまたきてねえええぇぇぇええ！:
Once you've cleared your jobs,
come agaiiiiin!
strings.仕事を片付けてから、\nまた来てね！:
Come back after you've
finished your work!
strings.仕事内容は至って簡単よ！\nタケシみたいなヘタレでも出来るわ！:
The job's super simple!
Even a wimp like Takeshi could do it!
strings.仕事命なんだね。: Guess he lives for his work.
strings.仕事柄、いろんな、デビルバスターの方と、\nお話する、機会があるのですが、:
Because of my job, I
get the chance, to talk
with, many different, Devil Busters,
strings.仕入れた商品は並べてあるから、\n適当に見ていってね。:
The goods I stocked are laid out,
so feel free to look around.
strings.仕入れた商品は並べてあるから、\n適当に見ていってね。\n季節品がおすすめよ～。:
The goods I stocked are laid out,
so feel free to look around.
I recommend the seasonal items~.
strings.仕入れた商品ば並べてあるけん、\n適当に見ていかんね。:
I've got the goods I stocked laid out,
so take a look around, won'tcha.
strings.仕入物の運搬を円滑にするために\nデビルバスターのライセンスもとったわ。:
I got my Devil Buster license too,
to make hauling my stock go smoother.
strings.仕方ありませんね。\n準備が出来たら、またいらしてください。:
It cannot be helped.
Please come again when you are prepared.
strings.仕方あるまい………………、\n祝いの酒を先に飲ませてやろう。:
Very well..................
I'll let you drink the
celebratory sake first.
strings.仕方がない……。実は、ほかの連中にも\n同様に依頼をしてある。:
It can't be helped......
Actually, I've made
the same request to some others too.
strings.仕方がないな……。\nやってやろう。:
Can't be helped...
I'll do it.
strings.仕方がないな。\nでは連れて行ってやろう。:
It cannot be helped.
Then I shall take you.
strings.仕方が無いから、オイラが街に送るホ！\nどの街に行くんだホ？:
It can't be helped, so I'll
send you to a town-ho!
Which town are you going to-ho?
strings.仕方ない、貴様にコレをやろう。\nありがたく思うのだぞ。:
Fine, I'll give you this.
Be grateful.
strings.仕方ないです。\n私のような歴史のあるＮＰＣにおいては:
It can't be helped.
For an NPC with a history like mine,
strings.仕方ないですねー。\nまたお願いしますよー。:
Oh well.
I'll be counting on you again.
strings.仕方ないので、バベルにいる業者に\n手配をしたのですが……:
So I had no choice but to arrange
for a supplier in Babel...
strings.仕方ないホ…… そんな無知蒙昧にして\n無学浅識な恥知らずデビルバスターに:
Can't be helped, ho... For
an ignorant, benighted,
uneducated, shallow, shameless
Devil Buster like you,
strings.仕方ないホ……。教えてあげるけど、\n聞くだけで実践したらだめホ！ 約束ホ！:
Can't be helped, ho... I'll
tell you, but only listen -
don't put it into
practice, ho! Promise, ho!
strings.仕方なしに穴から出てきたんじゃが、\n再び『異界新宿バベル』へ戻ろうにも:
So I had no choice but to
come out through the hole,
but when I tried to go back to
"Otherworld Shinjuku Babel",
strings.仕方ネェ、俺のために\n今すぐ荷物に空き作ってこい！ 頼む！:
Can't be helped. For my sake, go make
some room in your bags
right now! Please!
strings.仕組んだのはアナタですね！: You're the one who set this up!
strings.他では見たことのないアイテムを\n見てみたい？:
You want to see items you've
never seen anywhere else?
strings.他に、『御魂強化』という新たな強化も\n利用できるようになるのじゃ。:
Also, a new enhancement called
"Mitama Enhancement"
becomes available.
strings.他に、東京の亡骸に紛れてたっつー噂も\n聞いたことがあるぜ。:
I've also heard rumors it was mixed in
with the remains of Tokyo.
strings.他に『速成』の悪魔を所持しているなら\nそいつに授けてやるから呼び出してくれ。:
If you have another
"Rapid Growth" demon,
summon it and I'll
bestow it on that one.
strings.他にお見せいただけるものは\nございますでしょうか？:
Is there anything else
you could show me?
strings.他には……。\nイイニオイのする花……。:
What else...
Flowers that smell nice...
strings.他には……。\n幻と言われるスナックがあるらしい。:
What else...
there's apparently a legendary snack.

strings.少しは落ち着いていけ…。\nまあ私の知り合いにもそんなヤツはいるが…。:

maybe I'll get a little
faster, y'think?

I said something

stock up on a ton of T-shirts!

an intense bloodlust.

Sort it out a bit,
then come back.

It's a little disappointing,

make another request.

There's something I'd

that kind of spirit.
strings.少なくともタケシの所で\n買うんじゃないわよ！:
At the very least,

a small, elite team so you

merry mood, it seems!

An Alp has settled in

Thoth has settled in
the Residential Sector.

A Dwarf has settled in
the Residential Sector.
strings.居住区画にモムノフが住み着きました。:
A Mononofu has settled in
the Residential Sector.
strings.屈指の難易度になっておるじゃろう。\n心して挑むがええ。:
in all of Otherworld Shinjuku Babel.
Go in prepared.

The stalls are up and

strings.属性ＮＥＵＴＲＡＬに寄っちゃいますよ！:
Your alignment's gonna

The new "Chain Expert" handed

Commander Yamamoto let it

Get Goat Seals (needs 4

Reduce what you carry
just a little,

to confront your own reflection,
I will guide you any number of times.

Show thine own book, and offer

To take what you desire

Eat that which heightens your own
wisdom and brings us immortality.

I like your spirit, taking on the

It can't be helped.

strings.巷では、ラセツモードジャックフロストとか\n呼ばれてたり呼ばれてなかったりするホ:

Rakshasa Mode Jack Frost, ho!

Returning it,

go on waiting for a loved one

A place where you keep
taking damage......

a dream and an illusion...?

I am deeply moved!

the Prayer of Eternal Night

Human who fought in this
land with your demons
through the Prayer of Eternal Night.

For a Devil Buster who faces demons
directly day in and day out,

I'd rather try on the
boots than the hat...

Why are YOU dressed like
that, Mr. Heiwajima?
strings.平安と呼ばれた古の時代の超人……\nドウマンの力を彼女は利用しました。:
A superhuman of the ancient
era called Heian......

On weekdays we do 2 shows
from the evening, and on
weekends and holidays,
3 shows from noon!

I'm glad I trusted you.

Is it really fine?

I need to reflect on that...
I'll apologize when he comes again.

Maybe from age, a lot of the cubes

 in the New Year event
 "Do Devil Busters Dream of Demon Sheep?",

 "Shinagawa True Ice Cave".
strings.年末年始イベント\n \"ＤEVｉｌ ＨOｒSE ＲｉSｉNｇ\"に\n 登場す:
If equipped when talking to the NPC "Kinnari"
 in the New Year event
 "DEVil HOrSE RiSiNg",
 she will take you to
 "Shinagawa True Ice Cave".
strings.年配の人自体が少ないような……。:
There just aren't many elderly
people in general......

It feels different somehow from the calm

Well, whatever. I'll find out
your true nature eventually.
strings.幸いにも、ユダ様が遣わした者が\n大天使様とともに:
Fortunately, rumor has it that someone
sent by Lord Judas,
together with an Archangel,

You look happy...
Are you truly happy?

Having friends to share
happiness with is wonderful.

If you ruin that happiness,

Happiness?
Oh, maybe you're right!
Maybe it's happiness more than fun!
I see.
So this is what happiness is!
I'm happy being with you too!
Really!

This place is full of illusions.

...Oh, I'm sorry.
I ended up talking to myself...
I'm really sorry.

human society is headed.

It's not a hallucination

and raise the Genma DLv

What do you think

strings.幻魔・クー・フーリンについて \nどう思いますか？:
What do you think
of the Fiend Cu Chulainn?
strings.幻魔・セタンタについて \nどう思いますか？:
What do you think
of the Fiend Setanta?
strings.幻魔・ハヌマーンについて \nどう思いますか？:
What do you think
of the Fiend Hanuman?
strings.幻魔・ハヤグリーヴァについて \nどう思いますか？:
What do you think
of the Fiend Hayagriva?
strings.幻魔・ヴァルキリーについて \nどう思いますか？:
What do you think
of the Fiend Valkyrie?
strings.幼女ぉぉぉぉ！\n幼女ぉぉぉぉ！:
A little girlllll!
A little girlllll!

Wrapped as it is in
deep, dim darkness,
it certainly seems
like a demon den, but

I'll catch the ghost, put
a rope around its neck,
and sh-sh-show it off to everyone...
strings.幽霊如きと間違えるとは貴様ァ……、\n塩貰いたい様だ、ぬぁァアア！:
Mistaking me for a mere

looks like you want some
salt thrown at you, nwaaaah!
strings.幽鬼の姿が見えるのか……\nそんなお主ならば:
You see the Haunts...
For someone like you,
strings.幽鬼の姿が見えるのか……。\nそんなお主ならば:
You see the Haunts...
For someone like you,
strings.幾ばくかマシな改造や強化を\n施せる様になるじゃろうて。:
you should be able to modify and
strengthen them into
something a bit better.
strings.店やバザー等に置いてあるぞ。\nまた、一部の敵を倒した場合にも:

shops and the bazaar.

shops and the bazaar.

strings.店やバザー等に置いてあるわよ。\nまた、一部の敵を倒した場合にも:

shops and the bazaar.
Also, some enemies, when defeated,
strings.店やバザー等に置いてあるんだよ。\nまた、一部の敵を倒した場合にも:
They're sold in shops and the bazaar.
Also, some enemies, when defeated,
strings.度々すまない！\n園原杏里を見なかったか！？\n一体どこに行ったんだ…！:
Sorry to keep bothering you!
Have you seen Anri Sonohara!?
Where on earth did she go...!
strings.度が過ぎれば我らが主も\n心配が過ぎ、どうなってしまわれるか…。:
If it goes too far, our
lord may worry so much,
there's no telling what
will become of her...

If it goes too far, our lord may worry
so much that there's no
telling what happens...
strings.引きとめてしまって申し訳ない。\n私の名はジャンヌ。:
I'm sorry to have stopped you.
My name is Jeanne.

Crystals are a secret art
realized through the special
power known as Merging.
In Shinjuku Babel, there should be a man
well versed in the knowledge of Merging.
You would do well to visit him.
May you be greatly blessed...

You'll take it on?
Then I'll leave it to you!
I'm looking forward to it♪

So you won't take it on...

Finish up the jobs you've taken on,

strings.引き換えることのできるアイテムは&#10;:
The items you can
exchange for are
strings.引き続きよろしく頼んだぞ。: I'm counting on you to keep it up.
strings.引き続きデビルバスターとして\n研鑽を積むが良いぞ。:
Keep on honing yourself
as a Devil Buster.
strings.引き際が肝心: Knowing when to pull back is key
strings.引き際を\n見極めるのはもっと大切よ。:
knowing when to pull back
is even more important.
strings.引く、を選択しました。\n数値を選んでください。:
You chose Subtract.
Choose a number.
strings.引っ叩いたら攻撃された……。: I smacked one and it attacked me...

I'm glad you fell for it
so perfectly... you know.

Demon Me Take, Me No Give Back.
You Say Goodbye Already?

Weak as it is, it's way stronger than

He helps the weak and
crushes the strong,

The Daily Missions, built

1 time per 1 day, I

strings.既にアルチザンを使っておるお主だが、\nこれをショボく感じる必要はないぞ。:
You're already using Artisan,
but there's no need
to feel this is lame.
strings.既にアンタの仲間が\n手伝ってくれてるホー。:
Your companions are already
helping us out-hooo.
strings.既にクエストはクリアしているようですね\n是非、話を聞いていっておくれ。:
Looks like you've already
cleared the quest.
Do stay and listen to
what I have to say.
strings.既にクエストは受けているようですね\n是非、話を聞いていっておくれ。:
Looks like you've already
accepted the quest.
Do stay and listen to
what I have to say.
strings.既にナーヴィスを使っておるお主だが、\nこれにアルチザンを組み合わせれば、:
You're already using
Nervis, but if you
combine it with Artisan,
strings.既にプラグイン【アタバク】を\n所持しているみたいだよ。:
Looks like you already have
the plugin [Atavaka].
strings.既に入手できる状態になっているようだ。:
It seems it's already
available to obtain.
strings.既に別のプログラムがついてるな。:
You already have a different
program installed.
strings.既に各街の『ターミナル』にも\nプログラムをインストールしてあるぞ。:
The program has already been installed
in the "Terminal" of
each town as well.
strings.既に君にはプログラムを渡しただろう。:
I already gave you the
program, didn't I?
strings.既に役目を終えているようだ。:
It seems it has already
served its purpose.
strings.既に扉は開いている。奥へ進もう。:
The door is already open.
Let's go further in.
strings.既に持っておるじゃないか\nもっておる者には渡せんのぉ:
You already have it, don't you?
I can't give it to one
who already has it.
strings.既に時間も経っている。\n存命している可能性はゼロに近いだろう。:
A lot of time has already passed.
The chance they're still
alive is near zero.
strings.既に穴が閉じておっての……。なので、\n諦めてまたここに帰ってきたんじゃ。:
the hole had already
closed... So I gave up
and came back here again.
strings.既に習得しているようだ。: It seems you've already learned it.
strings.既に習得しているスキルは\n習得できないよ～。:
It can't learn skills
it already knows~.
strings.既に見つけているかもしれないが、: You might have already found them, but
strings.既に進入したモノがいます。\n後を追いますか？:
Someone has already entered.
Follow after them?
strings.既に道は開かれているようだ。:
The way seems to have
already been opened.
strings.日々、『大絵馬』の横でこうしているうち、\n奉納される『悪魔絵馬』によって、:
While I've been here beside
the "Great Ema" day after day,
I noticed that depending on
the "Demon Ema" offered,
strings.日に日に強力なデビルバスターになると、\nより多くのニンゲンの目に晒されると思い:
As you become a mightier
Devil Buster day by day,
I thought you'd be seen
by more and more humans,
strings.日を改めろ。\nそうしたら、また力を分けてやる。:
Come back another day.
Then I'll share my
power with you again.
strings.日本でも七福神の一、弁財天として名が通っていたことがあった……。\nなどと、聞い:
I have heard that in Japan,
too, she was once well known
as Benzaiten, one of
the Seven Lucky Gods.
strings.日本にソースがある悪魔、妖怪ってやたら人を食べるわよね。\n日本ていうかアジアか:
Demons and yokai that come from
Japan sure eat a lot of people.
Or maybe Asia rather than Japan.
I bet all sorts of history is
involved. Like food shortages.
Thinking about it that way,
demons are really fascinating.
strings.日本人なのか、そいつ…。\n知り合いにロシア人はいるにはいるがな。\nまあ、今度:
Is that guy Japanese...?
I do know a Russian guy.
Well, I'll ask him next time.
strings.日本神話に登場する剣の神を\n連れてきて欲しい。:
I want you to bring me the sword god
that appears in Japanese mythology.
strings.旦那さんが……あ、これは秘密！: Her husband... oh, that's a secret!
strings.旧イチガヤ駐屯地Boss用新規BGM: New BGM for Old Ichigaya Camp boss
strings.旧イチガヤ駐屯地へ行く状態にする:
Set state as going
to Old Ichigaya Camp
strings.旧イチガヤ駐屯地ボス部屋へ: To Old Ichigaya Camp boss room
strings.旧イチガヤ駐屯地七支刀チェック\n必要条件満たしている？:
Old Ichigaya Camp
Seven-Branched Sword check
Are the requirements met?
strings.旧イチガヤ駐屯地七支刀チェック >>:
Old Ichigaya Camp Seven-Branched
Sword check    >>
strings.旧イチガヤ駐屯地前: In front of Old Ichigaya Camp
strings.旧イチガヤ駐屯地（金）で入手できる。:
You can get it in Old
Ichigaya Camp (Gold).
strings.旧・帝都地下鉄 シブヤ駅前:
In front of Old Imperial
Capital Subway Shibuya Station
strings.旧・帝都地下鉄に出現する\n『ライジュウ』４０体、:
40 "Raiju" that appear
in the Old Imperial Capital Subway,
strings.旧・帝都地下鉄に出現する\n『ライジュウ』４０体と:
40 "Raiju" that appear
in the Old Imperial Capital Subway,
strings.早いとこ『ヘナの実』を\nアナトに持っていってくれよな。:
Hurry up and take "Henna Fruit"
to Anat, would ya?
strings.早く、お菓子を集めてきてよ！\nあなたいい人なんでしょ？:
Hurry up and collect the candy!
You're a good person, right?
strings.早くするんだな。\nそれとも、やめたくなったか？:
Hurry it up.
Or have you decided to quit?
strings.早くそこらのスイカを割ってこいよ！:
Hurry up and go smash some
watermelons around here!
strings.早速、通信か……。\nちょっと待ってくれ。:
A transmission already......
Hold on a moment.
strings.早速、鍵を使ってエレベーターに乗るホ！\n覚悟はＯＫ？ ブラザー。:
Let's use the keys and
hop on the elevator, ho!
You ready? Brother.
strings.早速、鍵を使ってエレベーターに乗るホ！\n覚悟はＯＫ？ ブラザー。\n（『牢獄の:
Let's use the keys and
hop on the elevator, ho!
You ready? Brother.
("Prison Key" owned: <ItCount:21657>)
strings.早速、鍵を使って仲間のいるエレベーターに\n乗るホ！ 覚悟はＯＫ？ ブラザー。\:
Let's use the keys and ride
the elevator your buddies
are on, ho! You ready? Brother.
("Prison Key" owned: <ItCount:21657>)
strings.早速だが、\nひとつ頼まれてくれるかね。:
Straight to it, then -
could you do me one favor?
strings.早速だけど、まずは愛について\nお勉強してもらっていいかしらん。:
Right away, could I have you
study up on love first?
strings.早速仲魔に溜めた経験を移せるが\n準備はいいんだろうな？ ああ？:
I can transfer the stored
experience to your demon
right away. You ready? Huh?
strings.明かりに照らされる\n夜のビーチって素敵！:
The beach at night
lit up by the lights is lovely!
strings.明日……この街の子供たちに、\n歌を教えてあげるんです。\n楽しみだなぁ……。\:
Tomorrow... I'm going to teach
the kids in this town some songs.
I can't wait...
I'd be so happy
if they came to love singing.
I'm all fired up,
thinking "I'll give it
everything I've got!"
strings.明日になるまで他のお姉さんたちからは\n貰えなくなっちゃうけど、:
you won't be able to get
one from the other ladies
until tomorrow,
strings.明日になるまで他のお姉さんたちからは\n貰えなくなっちゃうけど、\nそれでも構わ:
you won't be able to get
one from the other ladies
until tomorrow,
is that all right?
strings.明日までに、アイテムの整理を\nしておいてください。:
Please sort out your items
by tomorrow.
strings.明日までに、アイテムの整理を\nしておいて下さい。:
Please sort out your items
by tomorrow.
strings.昔…。\nそんな事を言ってたやつを見たことがあるな…。\nどんなやつかは秘密だけ:
A long time ago...
I saw a guy who said
something like that...
Who it was is a secret, though.
strings.昔、セル…タワーというビルが。:
Once, there was a building
called the Cell... Tower.
strings.昔、俺があっちの世界とこっちの世界を\n行き来してたときに見つけたんだ。:
I found it way back when I was going
back and forth between
that world and this one.
strings.昔から優秀なデビルバスターだった。:
He was an excellent Devil
Buster back in the day.
strings.昔この国には十代で乱の象徴となった者が居るらしい。\nお前は知っているのか？\n:
Apparently, long ago in this country,
there was someone who became a symbol
of rebellion as a teenager.
Do you know of him?
...What?
He exists as a demon?
...What on earth.
How unpleasant...
Go slay a demon like that.
You can do that, can't you?
strings.昔なんて思い出さないよ。: I don't think about the past.
strings.昔の話なんですけどなんですけど……。\n「シブヤ」って……。\n有名な像があった:
This is about the old days...
Apparently "Shibuya"...
had a famous statue...
Do you know what it was?
strings.昔はな…。\n今は…。\nまあ、知り合いの仕事を手伝ってる。:
Used to be...
Now...
well, I help out with a friend's work.
strings.昔はアンタが腕につけてるオモチャに\n「いんすとーる」する:
In the old days, you
needed to "in-stall"
a program on that toy on your arm,
strings.昔も大変だったんだ……。: So it was hard back then too...
strings.昔世話になった仲魔に貰った\nお守りを使ってやる。:
I'll use a charm I got from a demon
that took care of me back in the day.
strings.昔歌手を目指してたからなぁ……。: He wanted to be a singer once...
strings.昔ＩＣＢＭが落ちた場所。: Where an ICBM fell long ago.
strings.星霜の氷片を宝物と交換する:
Trade Frost Shards
of Ages for treasure
strings.是非、ご確認くださいっ！: Please go ahead and check it!
strings.是非、その方々の為にお力を\n振るわれてください。:
Please, wield your power
for their sake.
strings.是非、仲良くしてあげてね。\nぜぇぜぇ……。:
Please be good friends with them.
Huff, huff......
strings.是非、仲魔にしたいですね！: I'd love to make one my partner!
strings.是非、仲魔にしたいです！: I'd love to make you my partner!
strings.是非、常設劇場『Ｐ．Ａ．Ｒ．Ｍ．Ｓ』まで\n会いに来ていただけると嬉しいです！:
so we'd be thrilled
if you came to see us
at our permanent theater, "P.A.R.M.S"!
strings.是非、後ろに乗ってみたいですね。: I'd love to ride on the back.
strings.是非、話しかけてあげてね。\nぜぇぜぇ……。:
Please go talk to them.
Huff, huff......
strings.是非、貴方の力を\nわたくしに貸して頂きたいのです。:
I would very much like you
to lend me your power.
strings.是非このサイン、俺に\n鑑定させてくれないか？:
Won't you let me
appraise this autograph?
strings.是非ご活用ください。: Please make good use of it.
strings.是非とも、\n目指してもらいたいものじゃ。:
By all means,
aim for it.
strings.是非とも無事で見つかって欲しいと\n願っています。:
I pray with all my heart that they're
found safe.
strings.是非とも見ていってくださいね！: Please be sure to have a look!
strings.昼間のビーチ、夕方のビーチ、\n夜のビーチから選べるぜ！:
You can choose from the daytime beach,
the evening beach,
and the night beach!
strings.昼間の暑いビーチもいいけど、\n夕焼けに染まる海も素敵だね！:
The hot beach in the daytime is nice,
but the sea dyed by the
sunset is lovely too!
strings.時々……。\n「ジャックフロスト」を模した……。\nそんな帽子を被ってる方がいま:
Sometimes...
I see people wearing hats
modeled after "Jack Frost."
I want one too,
do you know where to get one?
strings.時々……。\nお酒を片手に持った方が、\n私のことを覗きにくるんですが……。\n:
Sometimes...
there's a man with a drink in his hand
who comes to peep at me...
What should I do...?
strings.時々……。\nどこかの学校の制服を着た、\nそんな黒髪の女の子を見かけます。\n:
Sometimes...
I see a black-haired girl
wearing some school's uniform.
The way she talks,
the things she says
are kind of unique...
Do you happen to know her?
strings.時々……。\n子供とかに歌を聴かせたりするんです。\n子供って……。\n正直に感:
Sometimes...
I sing for the kids and such.
Kids...
tell you exactly what they think.
They often tell me it's terrible.
And every time, I think,
"I'll do better!"
strings.時々……。\n悪魔さんに乗ってる人を見かけます。\nあれってどんな感じなんですか:
Sometimes...
I see people riding demons.
What does that feel like?
Does the wind feel nice?
strings.時々、夕焼けが見たくて外に出るんです。\n危ないってわかるんですけど、\n夕焼け:
Sometimes I go outside because
I want to see the sunset.
I know it's dangerous, but
sunsets are so beautiful, aren't they?
It's like my heart is washed clean,
like the warmth seeps right into me...
strings.時々お話したりするんですよー。\nいろいろとお話をしてくれて、ホントに良い人です:
We talk sometimes.
She tells me all sorts of things,
she's a really nice person.
If you'd like, why don't you
try talking to her too, Devil Buster?
strings.時々ここで発声練習するんですけど、\n最初は……。\n街の人がジロジロ見てきて、:
I sometimes do vocal exercises here,
and at first...
people in town would stare at me,
and it was embarrassing.
But lately...
that doesn't happen at all anymore.
I wonder if they've gotten used to it?
strings.時々外でデビルバスターさんが、\n悪魔さんにお金とか渡してますけど……。\nあれ:
Sometimes outside I see Devil Busters
handing money and stuff to demons...
Why do they do that?
strings.時がきたら、一気に突入して\nセンソーだホーー！！:
When the time comes, we'll charge in
all at once - it's WAR, hooo!!
strings.時が止まった様な顔をしつつ聞く: Listen with a face like time stopped
strings.時が経っても、\nその友人を見捨ててはなりません。:
Even as time passes,
you must not forsake those friends.
strings.時が経てば干渉できそうだ。:
You could interfere with
it once some time passes.
strings.時にはこういう相手も必要だホ！:
Sometimes you need an
opponent like this, ho!
strings.時には心だけでは無く、\n体すら焦がれる事があるかもしれません。:
At times, not only your heart
but even your body may
burn with longing.
strings.時の気、反照せし道: The path reflecting the air of time
strings.時を忘れて光を放つといわれる\n幻の霜…。:
A phantom frost said to shine
with light, forgetful of time...
strings.時刻や月齢なんかのシチュエーションも\n大事って事を忘れちゃダメよ～ん。:
don't forget that the situation, like
the time of day and moon
phase, matters too~
strings.時折気配の濃くなるあの「扉」の事じゃな。\n今まさに気配は最強のようじゃ。:
Ah, that "door" where the
presence grows stronger
at times. Right now, it
seems to be at its peak.
strings.時空の狭間が広がって現実世界にも…。:
The rift in space-time has
spread into the real world...
strings.時間がありましたら、\n是非とも、ご利用ください。:
so if you have the time,
by all means, make use of it.
strings.時間があるなら行って話だけでも\n聞いてみてやってくれよ。:
If you've got time, go on over
and at least hear her out.
strings.時間ができたらでいいから\nまた話しかけてくれな！:
Whenever you've got the time is fine,
so talk to me again!
strings.時間が空いたらまた、声をかけてくれ。:
Talk to me again when
you have some free time.
strings.時間が空いた時でよい。\nこの年寄りの話に耳を傾けてくれ。:
Whenever you have time is fine.
Lend an ear to this old man's tale.
strings.時間経つと、お礼を渡せないから\n早めに戻ってきてね～。:
If too much time passes,
I can't give you
the reward, so come back soon~.
strings.普段、何気ないことが何気なくできている…:
The ordinary things you do every day,
you do without a second thought...
strings.普段はこんなことしないんだけど、\nちょっと手を貸してやろうと思ってね。:
I don't usually do this sort of thing,
but I thought I'd lend a hand.
strings.普段は入れないところに……: I'd go places I normally can't...
strings.普段は入れないところに……。: I'd go places I normally can't...
strings.普段は月齢が１８０回変わるまで\n再び入ることが許されない……。:
normally you're not allowed back in
until the moon phase
changes 180 times...
strings.普段アンタがどれだけ強くても、\n雪合戦では関係ないホ！:
However strong you normally are,
it doesn't matter in
a snowball fight, ho!
strings.普段？\nんー……。\n殆ど変わらないわよ？\nあまり裏表のない子だもの……。\:
Usually?
Hmm...
She's hardly any different, you know?
She's not one to be two-faced...
She's cheerful, lively, and very kind.
I could never be like her... hehehe.
strings.普通ならラクダに沢山のマグネタイト渡して\n作ってもらう物なんだけど、:
Normally you'd give the
camel lots of Magnetite
to have her make it, but
strings.普通に使っても開かなくなっちゃってます。\nてへ！:
it won't open if you use
it normally anymore.
Tee-hee!
strings.普通に考えて悪いことよね！？\nきっと罰が当たったんだわ。:
Normally you'd think that's
a bad thing to do, right!?
I bet he got divine punishment.
strings.普通に考えれば、ただの混線で済まされてしまうだろうね。\nでも…。\nこれがダラ:
Normally, you'd just write
it off as crossed wires.
But...
The fact that it's the Dollars'
site is truly fascinating.
strings.普通のおじさんだよ？: He's just a normal guy, isn't he?
strings.普通のトモダチ、未熟なトモダチ、\n非凡なトモダチ……。:
Normal friends, fledgling friends,
exceptional friends...
strings.普通のネックレスとかじゃないの？:
Isn't it just a regular
necklace or something?
strings.普通のホクトセイクンじゃダメらしいわよ。\n寂しいわねぇ…。:
Apparently a normal
Hokuto Seikun won't do.
How lonely...
strings.普通のロック解除をするなら\n逆にダメだと思うっパ。:
If you want a normal unlock,
this'll actually be
no good, I think-pa.
strings.普通？\nうーん……普通って何？\nそんなアイマイな答えじゃ伝わらないよ。\nも:
Average?
Hmm... what's average?
An answer that vague
doesn't tell me anything.
Answer properly.
Okaaay?
strings.景色が変わった気がする…。: The scenery seems to have changed...
strings.晴嵐五兵図をもらう: Get the Clear Storm Five Weapons
strings.暇…！？\nアハハ、君は失礼な事を言うね！\n今回の事は、ある意味仕事にも関係し:
Free time...!?
Ahaha, what a rude thing to say!
This is related to my work, in a sense.
Ah, it's nothing, don't worry about it.
strings.暇だったら中で暴れてる暴徒を\nぶっ飛ばして来てホー。:
If you're bored, go in and knock out
the rioters running wild in there, ho.
strings.暇ならそこのオニの話を\n聞いてやってくれないかい？:
If you've got time, would you listen
to what that Oni over
there has to say?
strings.暇なんですね。: You must have a lot of free time.
strings.暗いかなぁ？\nキレイでしょ。\nお空のお星様みたいな感じでさー。\nあなたの心:
Is it gloomy?
It's pretty.
Like the stars up in the sky.
Isn't it your heart that's gloomy?
That's why it looks that way to you.
Right?
strings.暗い夜道は気をつけなさい。: Be careful on dark roads at night.
strings.暗殺および失踪したデビルバスターの調査を行いましょう。:
Investigate the assassinated
and missing Devil Busters.
strings.暮憂之咆槌を渡さない:
Don't hand over the
Twilight Roaring Hammer
strings.暮憂之咆槌を渡す: Hand over the Twilight Roaring Hammer
strings.暴れている強い者の場所へ移動しました。:
You moved to where the
strong rampaging ones are.
strings.暴れている者の場所へ移動しました。:
You moved to where the
rampaging ones are.
strings.暴れている者の誰が来るかは誰もわからん。:
Nobody knows which of the
rampaging ones will come.
strings.暴力とか、そういうの嫌いなんだよ…。\nあ、でも観戦するのは好きだぜ。:
I hate violence and stuff like that...
Oh, but I like watching it.
strings.暴力的だな…。\nそんなんでホントに大丈夫なのか？:
That's violent...
Is that really okay?
strings.暴食の罪源を開放した: Released the Sin Source of Gluttony
strings.曰く、戦闘より悪魔学や科学知識の方面に\n精通しておるようじゃ。:
he says he's more versed
in demonology and
scientific knowledge than in combat.
strings.更なるお礼として経験値と\nデジタライズポイントをあげちゃうわ♪:
I'll give you EXP and
Digitalize Points
as an extra thank-you♪
strings.更なるご褒美として経験値と\nソウルポイントをあげちゃうわね。:
I'll give you EXP and Soul Points
as an extra reward.
strings.更に『鬼面トマト』を集めて、ビーチを盛り上げましょう。:
Gather even more "Demon-Face
Tomato" to liven up the beach.
strings.更にツリーを増やして、悪魔とも話してみましょう。:
Increase the trees even more
and try talking to the demons.
strings.更に面倒なことに、３体の象さん悪魔が\nアンタを邪魔してくるホ！:
Even more annoying, 3 elephant demons
will get in your way, ho!

strings.永遠の嘆きよ\n永遠の嘆きよ:
O eternal lament
O eternal lament

If you grant his

something useful to you.

Unclean!

Are you one who bears a role

Are you one who bears a role

to me,

to me in this land,
the more points [Run] you
should have accumulated.

I shall here create "Demon Ema"...!

strings.汝に感ずる『融合』たる心気、\n我に沁み入るものなり……。:

strings.汝に我が祝儀を授ける。: I bestow my gift upon thee.

for a mighty one such

the pure thoughts congealed

the ardent thoughts circling
within me, and their voice.

the mirror-clear thoughts melted
within me, and their voice.

that demon with you.

bear one of the seven crosses

not follow that same path.

and certain items

strings.流石、デビルバスターって感じだね♪: That's a Devil Buster for you♪

Some folks do terrible things

Deeper than the sea,
higher than the mountains

consumable items that have

And while my tears are snipped off,

words, you should become one step wiser.

Deep and quiet, an
unseen sludge is surely
beginning to form in the darkness-ho.

In front of Kurama

I forgot the chocolate I

Hand it over if you

The shop's merchandise changes

When you're ready,
talk to Incubus again.

When you're ready, talk to

When you're ready,
talk to Jeanne again.

When you're ready, talk to

When you're ready,
talk to Lilim again.

Our songs feature intense, heavy

underground idols,

strings.私たちアリス十番は、ジェイソンマスクを\n被り、客席へのダイブやボートでの航海、:
We, Alice Juuban, wear
Jason masks and do
all-out, never-before-seen
performances like
strings.私たちスチームガールズは\n地下アイドルとして、秋葉原にある:
We, Steam Girls, are
underground idols,
and at the permanent
theater in Akihabara
strings.私たちスチームガールズは、\nアリス十番の候補生ユニットとして、:
We, Steam Girls, are a trainee unit
for Alice Juuban,
strings.私たち一般人がいい仕事につくには\n素晴らしい履歴書用紙が必要なの！:
for us ordinary people
to get a good job,
we need a wonderful resume form!
strings.私だって、何を連れてきてもらうか\n考えに考えて決めたんですよ！:
I thought long and hard
about what to have you bring, too!
strings.私って\n女の色気がないんじゃないかな……。:
I think maybe I
don't have any feminine allure...
strings.私って角もあるけれど、それ以上に特殊な部分があるの…。\nいつもおなかが空くの、:
I have horns, but there's something
even more unusual about me...
I'm always hungry, and
everything looks delicious,
and in fact I can eat anything I
can put in my mouth and swallow,
and it even tastes reasonably good...
I think that's related
to the horns too...
Oboro has not just that
fluffy stuff on her head,
but also the trait of a beautiful voice,
so I think it's something similar...
Compared to that, mine's a bit... wild.
strings.私とあなたとの間に、友情が芽生えるようになる日がくるということでしょうか。\nそ:
Do you mean the day will come when
friendship blossoms between you and me?
I shall look forward to that day.
strings.私とあなたの関係は\n一体どのようなものなのでしょうね。\n曖昧な友であるならば:
What kind of relationship
do you and I have, I wonder?
If we are only vague friends,
perhaps clear hostility
would leave more of a
mark on both our hearts.
strings.私とあなたは、\n考えてみれば珍奇なる関係……。\n一体、いつまでこの間柄は続く:
When you think about it,
you and I have a curious relationship...
How long will this bond
of ours last, I wonder?
strings.私という存在は……。\nこの世界にどのような影響を\n及ぼすものなのでしょう……:
What kind of influence
might a being such as I
have on this world...?
strings.私としては社交場にいる悪魔から\n大量の香水を貰って来て欲しいわねぇ～。:
Personally, I'd like
you to bring back lots
of perfume from the
demons in the Lounge~
strings.私どものような存在に刺さったのでしょう。:
It must have pierced
beings such as us.
strings.私どもは、\nできるだけ遭いたくないのですが:
We'd rather not run into it
if we can help it, but
strings.私ならどんな粗悪品でも\n売りつける自信があるのに！:
I'm confident I could sell anyone
even the shoddiest junk!
strings.私に、いかばかりのお話が出来るものか\nわかりませんが:
I do not know how much
I can tell you, but
strings.私にとっては、偉大なる父でもある神…\nあなたにとって\n父とはどういう存在です:
For me, God is also the great Father...
What kind of being
is a father to you?
strings.私にとっては、偉大なる父でもある神……。\nあなたにとって\n父とはどういう存在:
For me, God is also the great Father...
What kind of being
is a father to you?
strings.私には無用だ。\n貴様に授けてやろう。:
I have no use for it.
I shall bestow it upon you.
strings.私には皆、様子がおかしいように\n見えてしまう……。:
To me, everyone seems
to be acting strangely...
strings.私にも１０８の必殺技が…。\n…。\nちなみに２９個ってどんなのがあるの？\n今:
I also have 108 special moves...
...
By the way, what kind of 29 are there?
I'd like you to tell me sometime.
strings.私に何か……用かしら？:
Is there something...
you want with me?
strings.私に何か御用でしょうか。: Is there something you need of me?
strings.私に何か用でしょうか。: Is there something you want with me?
strings.私に出来ることは、ここで我が主の無事を\n祈ることくらいしかありません……。:
All I can do here is pray
for my master's safety...
strings.私に対しての敬意であれば不要です。\nまずはあなた自身の行いを省みるのです。\n:
If this is meant as respect
for me, it is unnecessary.
First, reflect upon your own deeds.
Do so, and the way will open
without relying on such objects.
strings.私に救いを求めるのですね、強き者よ。:
You seek salvation
from me, strong one.
strings.私に斬り捨てられる前に\nとっとと行って来いッッッ！:
Get going before
I cut you down!!!
strings.私に見せるだけで、\nアイテムが戻ってくるなど思うなよ。:
Don't think you'll get the items
back just by showing them to me.
strings.私に言わせれば、知れたレベルだな。\n何を調子付いてるのかは知らんが:
but if you ask me, his
level is nothing special.
I don't know what he's so
full of himself about,
strings.私に話を聞きに来たのでしょうが、:
You have likely come to hear
what I have to say, but
strings.私に贈り物ですか…。\nこれはおいしそうなチョコレートですね。:
A gift for me...?
What delicious-looking chocolate.
strings.私に逆らうとどうなるか、\nじっくりと教えてあげる。:
I'll teach you, slowly and thoroughly,
what happens when you defy me.
strings.私に？\nいいえ……全く聞こえなかったわ。\nだからとても不思議なの。\n子を持:
Me?
No... I didn't hear a thing.
That's why it's so strange.
Perhaps it's one of the
mysteries of parenthood?
It really is... strange.
strings.私に？\nそうね……。\n今はそこまで想う人は居ないわね。\nそれに近い人はいる:
Me?
Well...
There's no one I love
that much right now.
There is someone close to it...
I owe that person a great deal.
They've helped me so many times...
I can't thank them enough...
There is someone like that...
...Who could it be... hehehe.
strings.私に？\n今は特にないわよ。\nただその言葉を聞いた時に感動しただけ……。\nふ:
To me?
Nothing in particular right now.
I was just moved when
I heard those words...
Hehehe...
Thank you for worrying about me.
strings.私ね、商売っていうのも、\nやってみたいと思ってたの。:
You know, I'd been wanting to try
this thing called business too.
strings.私ね、歌が大好きなの！\n小さいときからずっと歌ってる。\n聞いてくれるのはお父:
You know, I love singing!
I've been singing ever
since I was little.
The only ones who ever listened
were my dad and mom, though...
And so...
When we moved to Kakyou Castle,
I heard the most
beautiful singing voice.
A small red fairy was singing,
as beautifully as a bird.
That fairy is called "Kahaku"...
Ever since then, I've
longed for that voice.
I even tried to imitate it
with a little demo recording.
But no matter how hard I try...
I can't sing like "Kahaku."
I just don't know what to do anymore...
So I have just one favor to ask.
I want you to let me meet a "Kahaku."
I understand it's a hard
and cheeky request.
But... I want to meet one.
I'm sure if I meet one,
I'll understand something.
But a "Kahaku" out in the wild
might attack me...
So I want you to let me meet a
"Kahaku" that's your friend.
Will you grant me this favor?
strings.私ね、歌を歌いたい。\n聞いた人に幸せが満ちるような歌を。\nでも、今の私にはち:
You know, I want to sing songs.
Songs that fill whoever
hears them with happiness.
But right now, I can't
quite sing like that...
I don't really understand what it
means to be filled with happiness...
The other day, I asked
the owner about it.
And she told me that somewhere in Tokyo,
there's a "Kahaku" that's
filled with happiness.
Have you heard of it?
I... I want to meet that "Kahaku."
I want to meet it and
learn what happiness is...
I'm sure...
If I can do that, I'm sure...
Even my songs could make someone happy.
And more than anything... I
want to soothe my mother,
who's suffering from her
illness, even just a little.
I want to give her happiness.
Please.
It might be a really
unreasonable request, but
could you let me meet
that "Kahaku" filled with happiness?
strings.私のいうこと、きいてくれないんだー！\nウェーン！ ひどいよー、ひどいよー！:
You won't listen to me!
Waaah! You're mean, you're mean!
strings.私のお友達のお話をするわね。\nその子……子供がいるのだけど、\nその子の為に服:
Let me tell you about a friend of mine.
She has a child,
and she knitted clothes for her child.
They're adorably shaped clothes,
but she can't decide what
color to dye them...
When I told her to just
pick any color already,
she got terribly angry...
I'm sure she's enjoying every moment,
including the agonizing...
I was a little envious...
strings.私のお願いも引き受けてね！: please take on my request too!
strings.私のこの格好って……。\nやっぱりちょっと浮いてますよね？:
This outfit of mine...
It really does stand
out a bit, doesn't it?
strings.私のこの溢れんばかりの想いを、\n忘れぬよう文字にして残しました。:
I've put these overflowing
feelings of mine
into writing, so they
won't be forgotten.
strings.私のますたーの話を\n聞いてあげてね。:
Please listen to
what my master has to say.
strings.私のような特務を専門としている\nデビルバスターはやはり強いだろうな。:
specialize in special
duties like I do,
and we are, naturally, strong.
strings.私の主などは、見えそうで見えないところがいい！\nなどと言っていた時期もありまし:
There was a time when my
master said things like,
"What's great is how you can
almost see, but not quite!"
strings.私の事どう思ってる？: What do you think of me?
strings.私の事を、\nみんなスッカリ忘れていたという…。:
Everyone had completely
forgotten about me...
strings.私の人を見る目もたいしたものだわ。\n一応、注意しておくけれど、:
My eye for people is
pretty impressive too.
Just to warn you, though,
strings.私の他にも同じものを\n手に入れた者がいるようだが、:
It seems others besides me
have obtained the same thing, but
strings.私の力が必要なのね……。\n嬉しいわ。:
You need my power...
How delightful.
strings.私の力が欲しいなら、\n一度荷物を整理しなさぁい。:
If you want my power,
sort out your bags first.
strings.私の力が欲しい時は\n何時でもいらっしゃい……。:
Whenever you desire my power,
come to me any time...
strings.私の力でシブヤまで転送して差し上げます。\n準備はよろしいですか？:
I will use my power to
transfer you to Shibuya.
Are you ready?
strings.私の力はもう必要ないだろう……。:
You no longer need my
power, I'd think......
strings.私の力を授けましょう……！: I shall grant you my power...!
strings.私の口からは… どうにも…:
I really can't bring myself...
to say it...
strings.私の口から聞くよりイロイロ\n聞けちゃうと思いますよ。（暗黒微笑）:
I think you'll hear
all sorts of things
you wouldn't hear
from me. (dark smile)
strings.私の名はヒトミ。ハジメマシテ。\nデビルバスターよ。:
My name's Hitomi. Nice to meet you.
I'm a Devil Buster.
strings.私の声が、今は届かずとも……。\nいずれあなたはまたここに戻ってくるでしょう。\:
Even if my voice does
not reach you now...
You will surely return here someday.
For that is your karma.
strings.私の大切なアイテムを奪い取った\nニックキ悪魔達に復讐してきてください！！:
Get revenge on those hateful demons
who stole my precious items!!
strings.私の愛用してる香水を譲ってくれたら\nアイテムと交換してあげるわよぉ。:
If you give me the
perfume I love to use,
I'll trade you items for it.
strings.私の手元に使う予定もなく余らせてるのが\nあるから、安く譲ってあげる。:
I have a spare one on hand
with no plans to use it,
so I'll let you have it cheap.
strings.私の持っているアイテムとの交換とか\nどうでしょう？:
how about trading it for
an item I have?
strings.私の持っているアイテムとの交換とか&#10;\nどうでしょう？&#10;:
How about trading it for 

an item I have?
strings.私の方で扱っているストップウォッチは\n少々特殊なものでして……。:
The stopwatches I handle are
a little special...
strings.私の方は\n守衛の彼からようやく話が聞けそうだ。:
On my end, it looks like I can
finally get the guard to talk.
strings.私の本名？\nふふふ……。\nそれは教えてあげないわ。\nこのお店の中では、\n:
My real name?
Hehehe...
I won't tell you that.
Inside this shop,
I'm Aoi, no matter what...
If we ever meet somewhere else someday,
I'll tell you then...
strings.私の気のせいなだけかもしれませんが\nどうかお客様、くれぐれもお気をつけて！:
It may just be my imagination, but
dear customer, please do be careful!
strings.私の特訓を耐え抜いた者に、\nそのような口を利く者はいない。:
but no one who's survived my training
talks like that.
strings.私の目的が霞んでしまいそうだ……。: My purpose seems to be fading...
strings.私の知り合いが今度旅に出るみたいなんだけど、\n何かお守りになるようなものが欲し:
A friend of mine is
going on a journey soon,
and I thought it'd be nice to give
them some kind of good-luck charm.
So if you don't mind, could you
look for that charm for me?
I believe it's a gemstone or something
that's supposed to have
that kind of meaning...
Would you do this for me?
strings.私の素敵なプレゼントを\nあなたに贈るわ。:
I'll give you
my lovely present.
strings.私の自慢の仲間だよ。: She's a comrade I'm proud of.
strings.私の血を！\n…。\nあなたといるとペースを乱されるわ…。:
My blood!
...
Being with you throws me off my pace...
strings.私の話を聞いてくださいよぉ～！:
so please listen to
what I have to say~!
strings.私の遣いを受けるには\n少々力不足のようだな。:
but you're a bit lacking in strength
to run my errand.
strings.私の野望も、私のことも知らない\nニューフェイスが続々参入して:
New faces who don't know my ambitions
or even who I am have been
joining one after another,
strings.私の隣に大型の端末装置があるだろう？:
There's a large terminal device
next to me, isn't there?
strings.私の髪型って変じゃないですよね？: My hairstyle isn't weird, is it?
strings.私の魔人になるという夢と野望を、現実の\nものとする素敵アイテム、それが闘魂！:
The wonderful item that will
make my dream and ambition
of becoming a Fiend a
reality: Fighting Spirit!
strings.私の魔人化への道を\n手伝ってくれるんですか！？:
You'll help me on my path
to becoming a Fiend!?
strings.私は、あなたに媚を売りたくて\nここにいるわけではありません！:
I am not here because
I want to curry favor with you!
strings.私は、お前の事を…。\nなんというか親友だと思っている…。\nこれからもよろしく:
I think of you as...
how should I put it, my best friend...
I'm counting on you from here on, too.
strings.私は、そのことを\nとある方よりお伺いしておりました。:
I had heard of this
from a certain person.
strings.私は、封印されし悪魔とこの輝きは\n関係があるんじゃないかと思っている。:
I think this radiance
might have something
to do with the sealed demons.
strings.私は、火炎耐性なのでお話になりません。:
I resist Fire, so that's
out of the question.
strings.私はあまり本気にしていないのですが…: I don't take it very seriously, but...
strings.私はお金儲けのことで大変なんだから！: I'm way too busy trying to make money!
strings.私はここから動けぬ身。\nあなたが時間を割いてここに着てくれていること\n嬉しく:
I cannot move from here.
I am glad that you take the time
to come here.
strings.私はここで子羊達の愛の行く末を\n見届けてるわ～。:
I'll stay here and watch over
the love of all my little lambs~
strings.私はこの手のイベントでは: At events like this, I often
strings.私はこれから夜が来るたびに思い出して、\nおぞけるのです。:
From now on, every time
night falls I'll remember,
and shudder.
strings.私はせめてしばらくの間、\n息を殺して身を潜めていようと思います…。:
I think I'll at least hold my breath
and lie low for a while...
strings.私はどちらでもありません。\n自分が正しいから相手は悪いなんて考えた事もありませ:
I'm on neither side.
I've never thought "I'm
right, so they're wrong."
Because I think they're both right...
and they're both wrong, too...
...Am I strange?
strings.私はまた別の任務に戻ります。: I'm going back to another mission.
strings.私はアナタを見ています。\n次にお会いできる、その時まで。:
I am watching you.
Until the next time we meet.
strings.私はガスマスク地下アイドル集団\n「スチームガールズ」のセンター、:
I'm the center of the gas-mask
underground idol group "Steam Girls,"
strings.私はナオトラ。Ａ級デビルバスターだ。\n軍階級は大尉である。:
I am Naotora. An A-rank Devil Buster.
My military rank is captain.
strings.私はバレンタインの使者。\nみんなの愛を応援するものよ～。:
I'm the Valentine's Envoy.
I cheer on everyone's love~
strings.私はヘドバンアイドル「アリス十番」の\nセンター、立花あんなです！:
I'm Anna Tachibana, the center of the
headbanging idol group "Alice Juuban"!
strings.私はホワイトデーの使者。\nみんなの愛を応援するものよ～。:
I'm the White Day Envoy.
I cheer on everyone's love~
strings.私はメシア教の依頼で\nモノ探しをしているのだけど、:
I'm searching for something
at the request of the Messians, but
strings.私は一度、仲間たちとともに\nサタンの討伐に向かったが、:
I once went with my comrades
to defeat Satan, but
strings.私は今… あなたの心に…\n直接… 呼びかけています…:
I am now... calling out...
directly... to your heart...
strings.私は地霊だけど、妖精たちは\nここに住んでいいよって言ってくれたの。:
I'm a Jirae, but the fairies
said I could live here.
strings.私は女である前に悪魔なのよ？:
Before I'm a woman,
I'm a demon, you know?
strings.私は彼を止められなかった……\n私の責任だ……。:
I couldn't stop him...
It's my fault...
strings.私は彼女が何か良からぬことに巻き込まれて\nいないか、心配で心配で……。:
I'm so worried that she's gotten
wrapped up in something bad...
strings.私は彼女を止められなかった……\n私の責任だ……。:
I couldn't stop her...
It's my fault...
strings.私は怪物…悪魔になんてならない。: I won't become a monster... a demon.
strings.私は愛の使者 サキュバス。\nみんなの愛を応援するものよ～。:
I'm the Envoy of Love, Succubus.
I cheer on everyone's love~
strings.私は愛の使者。ここにいるニンゲン達に\n愛を配っているのよ。:
I am a messenger of
love. I'm handing out
love to the humans here.
strings.私は戦場に赴かなかっただろう。:
I would never have gone
to the battlefield.
strings.私は掘ることしか能の無い女だから、\n掘り続けるだけなのだけれど。:
I'm a woman whose only
skill is digging,
so all I can do is keep digging.
strings.私は次元の狭間に住むデビルバスター！:
I am a Devil Buster who dwells
in the rift between dimensions!
strings.私は特定の者を特別扱いなどしないのだが、\n貴様には何か感じるものがある。:
I don't give special
treatment to anyone,
but I sense something in you.
strings.私は男性を\n魅了する悪魔ですもの。:
After all, I'm a demon
who enchants men.
strings.私は目を閉じていても、\nお前の近づくのが分かる。:
Even with my eyes closed,
I know when you approach.
strings.私は目的を果たす為に、\nある邪魔者を排除したいのですが……。:
To achieve my goal, I wish to
eliminate a certain nuisance, but...
strings.私は考えました。何も救世主を\n待ち続けるばかりではないと。:
I thought. We need not just
keep waiting for a Messiah.
strings.私は見た事がないのですが、\n「シブヤ」はご存知ですか？\nそこは石ばっかりな場:
I've never seen it myself, but
do you know "Shibuya"?
I heard it's a place full
of nothing but stone.
Is that true?
strings.私は見てのとおり科学者で、\n様々な研究をしている。:
As you can see, I'm a scientist,
conducting all sorts of research.
strings.私は部下を見捨てたりはしない。\nいつでも特訓に戻ってくるがよい。:
I never abandon my subordinates.
Come back to train any time.
strings.私は魔獣を、アズラは堕天使を\n身体に宿して戦うんだ。:
I fight with a Beast
housed in my body,
and Azura with a Fallen.
strings.私も……それほど多くはありません……。\nでも、少しでも居ると嬉しいものですよね:
I... don't have that many either...
But even a few make
you happy, don't they?
You can talk to them
when you're in trouble.
You can chat about little things.
I'm always grateful.
Thank you for being my friend, I think.
Don't you feel that way?
strings.私も……貴方に与える物があるのよぉ……。:
I also... have something
to give you...
strings.私も、かつて見たあの出で立ちには恐れおののいたものです……。:
I too once trembled in fear
at the sight of him...
strings.私も、色々な「愛」を見てきたけどぉ～:
I've seen all sorts
of "love" too, but~
strings.私もあなたに渡したいものがあります。:
I too have something
I wish to give you.
strings.私もあなたに渡したいものがあるの。:
I have something I'd
like to give you too.
strings.私もおまえの力が見たいと思っていたよ。: I wanted to see your strength too.
strings.私もこの石のことはどこか気に掛かる。\n何かわかったなら教えてくれ。:
This stone bothers me somehow too.
If you find anything out, let me know.
strings.私もそう思います！\nやっぱり暖かい感じがしますよね。\n思わず笑顔になるような:
I think so too!
They really feel warm, don't they?
I feel a kindness in them that
makes you smile without meaning to.
I'm glad we share this feeling!
Thank you!
strings.私もそちらの世界では…きっと普通の存在なんだろうな。\nあ、いや、こっちの話だ。:
In your world... I'd probably
be completely ordinary.
Ah, no, never mind me.
strings.私もです！\n……。\n神の愛は無限大です。:
As do I!
...
God's love is infinite.
strings.私もね、日夜必殺技の研究を\nしているんだけど……、:
I've been researching finishing moves
day and night too, but...
strings.私もよく使います。: I use it a lot too.
strings.私もアナタに不思議なものを感じます。: I sense something strange about you too.
strings.私もバイトなんかせずに印税で暮らしたい！:
I wanna live off royalties instead
of doing part-time jobs too!
strings.私も実はダラーズのメンバーなんです。:
Actually, I'm a member
of the Dollars too.
strings.私も実際に目にしたのは\nこれが初めてです…。:
this is actually the first time
I've seen it with my own eyes...
strings.私も最初同じ事を考えたわ。\nでも店員でそういう被害を受けている人はいないの。\:
I thought the same thing at first.
But none of the staff has
had any such trouble.
So I'm sure that's not it.
What on earth was it...
A mysterious person... indeed.
strings.私も最初聞いたときはそう思ったんですよ。\n透き通る海とかの話なんて全然聞いたこ:
That's what I thought when
I first heard it too.
I'd never heard anything
about a crystal-clear sea...
But the person I talked to
the other day was serious.
I just couldn't think it was a lie...
Um... if possible, could
you look for it a little?
I'm sorry.
strings.私も池袋にいるんだが、案外近くと繋がってるんだな。\nしかし…池袋にそんな場所あ:
I'm in Ikebukuro too, so it's
connected somewhere pretty close.
But... is there a place
like that in Ikebukuro?
strings.私も海なんてないと思ってたの。\nでもあるデビルバスターの方が、\nとても綺麗な:
I thought there was no sea either.
But a certain Devil Buster said
he went to a very beautiful sea.
I thought maybe you'd
know about it too...
If you ever find out, won't you tell me?
strings.私も直接見たことはないんですけど、\n居るって話を何回か聞きました。\n綺麗な人:
I've never seen her myself,
but I've heard she's there a few times.
There are rumors that
she's beautiful too.
If you're interested,
why not explore "Suginami"?
strings.私も第三ラウンドまでは突破したけど、そこからが難しいわね…。:
I got through the third round too,
but it gets hard after that...
strings.私も長い間、ニンゲンをみてきたものです……。\n未熟であるのがニンゲンとはいえ、:
I too have watched humans
for a long time...
Immaturity may be the
nature of humans, but
they have also committed many sins...
From your perspective as a human,
do you think there is any life
that holds more potential than humans?
strings.私も頑張ってるんだよ。\nたいへんなのであります。:
I'm doing my best too, you know.
It's very hard work, it is.
strings.私も驚いたんですよ。\nしかもそれが誰かにお礼を伝える為だったとか……。\n凄い:
I was surprised too.
And apparently it was
to thank someone...
Amazing, isn't it?
How much do you think it cost...?
I'm sure I could never do that...
Well...
even if I could, there's nothing
I'd want to show off that much.
Hmm...
That's really amazing...
strings.私も黄巾賊です！: I'm one of the Yellow Scarves too!
strings.私も１度教習中に見かけましたが、\nなんといいますか、怖くなりました。:
I saw it 1 time during
training myself,
and, how should I put
it, I got scared.
strings.私より！\n若い女の！:
For a woman!
Younger than me!
strings.私よ私！\n前に色々とお世話になったハヅキよ！:
It's me, me!
Hazuki, who you helped out
with all sorts of stuff!
strings.私らしく、悪魔とかあちこちから集めてきて\nネット上にあった某グレーなゾーンに:
In true me fashion, I gathered
demons and stuff from all over,
and tossed them any old way
into a certain gray zone
strings.私を倒せると……。: You think you can defeat me...
strings.私を呼び出せる召喚器を欲するのですか。:
You desire a summoning device
that can call me forth?
strings.私を知ってる他のＤＢさんに\n聞いてみてくださいよ！！:
Go ask some other DB
who knows me!!
strings.私を護る者を\n傷つけずに終えていただいたようですね。:
It seems you finished without
harming the one who protects me.
strings.私デビルバスターじゃないから\n使えないのよね。:
I'm not a Devil Buster,
so I can't use it.
strings.私以外でだと？ そうだな、あえて言うなら\n若い頃の山本長官だろうか。:
Besides me? Well, if I had to say,
Commander Yamamoto
in his younger days.
strings.私共が求めるアイテムと\n交換する…というのはいかがでしょうか？:
How about trading for
the items we're looking for?
strings.私思うんですけど……。\n笑顔って連鎖しますよね？\n笑ってる人をみると……。\:
I was thinking...
smiles are contagious, aren't they?
When I see someone smiling...
it makes me happy too.
...Is that strange of me?
strings.私褒めてもらって伸びるタイプなんですよ！: I'm the type who grows with praise!
strings.私達、きっと相性が悪いんだわ。\nピクちゃんとでも話してきたほうがいいわよ。:
We must be a bad match.
You'd better go talk to Pix or someone.
strings.私達が召喚された時のチカラは、\n大きく異なるわ……。:
Our powers when summoned
are vastly different...
strings.私達が求める法と秩序に満ちた世界は、\n永遠に訪れなくなってしまう……。:
the world full of law
and order that we seek
will never come...
strings.私達の思想を受け入れるか？\nどうなのだ？:
Will you accept our ideals?
Well?
strings.私達の神には届かないらしい。: they apparently won't reach our god.
strings.私達の神はこちらへ来ていただけない。: our god will not come here.
strings.私達は、同じ目的のもと\n共闘すべきなのです。:
We should fight together
under the same goal.
strings.私達も負けてはいられない。: We cannot afford to lose either.
strings.私達メシア教団を照らすあの神が！:
That god who shines upon
the Messian Church!
strings.私？\n……そうね。\nそんな事もあるかもしれないわね……。\nどうしても行きづ:
Me?
...Well.
Perhaps something like that happened...
Places that are just
too hard to go to...
There certainly are places like that...
I wonder if there will be
more of them from now on...
When I think of that...
it's a little lonely...
strings.私？\nそうね……。\n私はあまり編み物が得意ではないの。\nだから普段はしない:
Me?
Well...
I'm not very good at knitting.
So I don't usually do it...
Only a little for my father's and
mother's birthdays, I suppose.
It was terrible compared
to the girl at the shop.
Hehehehehe...
strings.私？\nそうね……。\n言葉とかよりも服装かしら？\nなんて破廉恥な格好をしてる:
Me?
Let's see......
Rather than my words, it
was my clothes, perhaps?
It told me, "What a
shameless outfit you wear!"
But maybe it got used to it
after seeing me many times?
It doesn't say anything anymore......
Do you think this kimono......
is shameless too?
strings.私？\nふふふ……。\n私には子供はいないわ。\n夫すらいないもの……。\nでも:
Me?
Hehehe...
I don't have any children.
I don't even have a husband...
But you'd better be careful
with questions like that.
Some women would get angry.
Please be careful from now on...
strings.私？\nふふふ……。\n私は歌わないわ……。\nごめんなさいね。:
Me?
Fufufu......
I don't sing......
I'm sorry.
strings.私？\nふふふ……。\n私は歌姫とは呼ばれていないわよ。\nあの舞台で歌えるほど:
Me?
Hehehe...
No one calls me a diva.
I'm not good enough to
sing on that stage.
But if you think so,
it's embarrassing, but
it makes me happy.
...I'd like to sing for you someday...
strings.私？\nふふふふ……。\n私は戦ったりなんてできないわ。\n私の何処を見てそう思:
Me?
Fufufufu......
I couldn't possibly fight.
What about me made you think that?
Would you tell me in a bit more detail?
strings.私？\n私にはそのような経験はないわ……。\n両親は共に健在ですし、\n結婚をし:
Me?
I've never had such an experience...
Both my parents are alive and well,
and I've never been married...
But perhaps it will come someday.
I'm sure it comes to everyone someday...
When it does, I wonder
if I can bear it...
strings.私？\n私には自慢するような事なんてないわ。\n何処にでもいるような普通の女性だ:
Me?
I have nothing to brag about.
I'm just an ordinary woman
like you'd find anywhere...
But perhaps without realizing it, I...
...I'll think about it a little...
strings.私？\n私はそういう事はしないわね……。\nする事ももちろん嫌だと思ってしまうし:
Me?
No, I wouldn't do that sort of thing...
I'd hate to do it, of course,
and even more so when I think of
the other person's feelings...
That's why I'm surprised
by people who can do it.
You don't look like someone
who would either...
Or am I mistaken?
strings.私？\n私はどうなのかしらね……。\n今までの経験では、\n一応そういったことは:
Me?
I wonder about me...
In my experience so far,
nothing like that has
happened, at least.
But maybe I just haven't noticed?
...I wonder...
strings.私？\n私はないわ。\n恐ろしい場所だという噂が沢山あるのよ。\nあなたももし行:
Me?
I haven't.
There are lots of rumors that
it's a frightening place.
If you go,
please be careful.
strings.私？\n私は何もしていなかったわ。\nここでその方を眺めてただけ……。\nあの瞬:
Me?
I wasn't doing anything.
I was just watching him from here...
I think that was the right
thing at that moment.
I felt I mustn't intrude and spoil it.
...Was I wrong?
strings.私？\n私は真似してしまうわね。\n今でこそ真似ではなく参考にする程度なのだけれ:
Me?
I end up imitating.
These days it's only to the point
of using them as a reference,
but back then I truly imitated them.
Their clothes, the way they talked...
...Hehehe.
I really was a child...
strings.私？\n私は間違いなく選ばないと思うわ。\n永遠に生きたいと思った事がないもの。:
Me?
I definitely wouldn't choose it.
I've never wanted to live forever.
And losing someone dear to me...
That would be unbearable.
I wouldn't choose it...
strings.秋葉原のパセラ７Ｆで公演: Shows on 7F of Pasela in Akihabara
strings.秋赤音さんデザインの装備品を、\n装着しているじゃないですか！:
you're wearing equipment
designed by Akane Aki!
strings.秘密の部屋に入るにも\nお祝いのコインが必要なの。:
To enter the secret room,
you need Celebration Coins.
strings.秘密の部屋に行く？\nそれとも材料集めに行く？:
Will you go to the secret room?
Or go gather materials?
strings.秘密の部屋に行く？\nそれとも材料集めに行く？\nどっち？:
Will you go to the secret room?
Or go gather materials?
Which one?
strings.秩序なく、ただ暴力に明け暮れた世界は\n救済もなく、明日への絶望で満ち溢れる。:
A world without order,
given over to violence,
has no salvation and overflows
with despair for tomorrow.
strings.称号だね。\nう～ん、そうだな～～。:
A title, then.
Hmm~, let's see~~.
strings.移動→ダンジョンボス部屋デバッグイベント起動:
Move -> Start dungeon
boss room debug event
strings.移動→反対側のプラズマへ:
Move -> to the Plasma
on the opposite side
strings.移動したら引き返せない気がする…。\n>移動しますか？:
You feel like there's no
turning back once you move...
>Move?
strings.移動した先は不思議な場所でね。\nいくつかの木箱が置いてあるんだ。:
Where you end up is a strange place.
There are a number of
wooden crates there.
strings.移動やカメラを覚えましょう。:
Let's learn how to move
and use the camera.
strings.移動：スネークマンのいる部屋へ: Move: To the room with Snakeman
strings.移動：電子回廊入場口へ: Move: to the Cyber Corridor entrance
strings.稀によくある事だって、最近バベルに現れた\nナオトラおばさんも言ってました。:
it's a rare thing that happens
often, or so Auntie Naotora,
who recently showed up in Babel, said.
strings.稟議の承認が……\n派遣部隊の選定……:
Approval of proposals......
selection of a dispatch unit......
strings.種族ごとに絞り込んで見る事もできるから\nそれで確かめてみるといい。:
by race, so try
checking it that way.
strings.稼ぎ時とはいえ、クリスマスムードに\nあてられちゃった～。:
It's peak earning time, but
the Christmas mood got to me~.
strings.稽古を受けた証は、難易度が高いほど\n多く渡してやるから、:
The higher the difficulty,
the more proof of
training I'll give you,
strings.稽古中は、仲魔の召喚は封じさせてもらう。:
During training, I'll be
sealing off demon summoning.
strings.稽古中は、仲魔の召喚は封じさせてもらう。\nでなければ稽古にならんからな。:
During training, I'll seal
off your demon summoning.
Otherwise it wouldn't be training.
strings.積もる話もあるだろうが、\n今はやめておこう。:
I'm sure there's a lot to talk about,
but let's leave it for now.
strings.穢れない乙女に抱かれるとやっと落ち着くんだってね。\n聖獣のくせにえらい不純だわ:
I hear it only calms down when
embraced by a pure maiden.
For a holy beast, that's awfully impure.
strings.穴開いちゃってる…。\nそういえばこんなトウキョウになる前、あぁいう扇風機があっ:
It has holes in it...
Come to think of it, before Tokyo became
like this, there were fans like that.
Apparently without blades... you know.
Does Fuu-Ki blow wind
out of those holes too?
strings.空きができたらまた来なよ。: Come back when you've made some room.
strings.空きができたらまた来るのだぞ。: Come back once you've got room.
strings.空きをつくってからもう一度まいれ。: Make some room and come again.
strings.空きを作って出直してくるといいホ！\n待ってるホー！:
Make some room and come back, ho!
I'll be waiting, ho!
strings.空き２個の余裕ができたら\nまた来てくださいね。:
Once you have 2 free space,
come back again.
strings.空き２個の余裕ができたら、\nまた来てくださいね！:
Once you have 2 free space,
come back again!
strings.空けてみればよろしいのでは？: Why not open it and see?
strings.空には月立ちぬ気配。\n朔が運ぶ風に聞く役もあるやなしや。:
The moon is about to rise in the sky.
Perhaps some roles are heard on
the wind the new moon brings.
strings.空に浮かぶは満ち満ちた月。\n月影清かに運ばれる役もあるやなしや。:
In the sky floats a
moon full to brimming.
Perhaps some roles are
carried by its clear light.
strings.空間が歪んでいる。「扉」は開かないようだ…:
Space is distorted. The "door"
doesn't seem to open...
strings.空間に入ると、複数のチャレンジが\n順番に発生するの。:
When you enter the space, multiple
challenges occur in order.
strings.空間に更に歪みが生じ、力を呼び寄せたようです。:
The space warped even further and
seems to have drawn in some power.
strings.突き当たりを右に進んだ辺りで、\n『赤宵に立つ影』を見たっつーーんだよ。:
and says he saw "Shadow in
the Red Dusk" around where
you go right at the end of
the path, I'm tellin' ya.
strings.突っ込んで欲しいのはソコ！\nソコなんでした！！:
THAT'S what I wanted you to ask about!
THAT was it!!
strings.突如として、その消息を絶つことは\nそれほど珍しいことではないがな……。:
suddenly dropping out of contact
isn't all that rare......
strings.突撃のスキルが使える悪魔だけが覚えられる\nスキルホ！ その悪魔じゃ荷が重いホ！:
Only demons that can use
Thrust skills can learn
this skill, ho! It's too
much for that demon, ho!
strings.突撃を反射するという能力を持っているそうです。\n遭遇の際には注意が必要ですね。:
She is said to have the
ability to reflect Thrust.
Caution is needed when
you encounter her.
strings.突撃相性無効発生確率が上昇する。:
Raises the chance of
nullifying Thrust affinity.
strings.突然\n私のＣＯＭＰ内に発生したの。:
it suddenly appeared
inside my COMP.
strings.突然だがな、私は菩薩の様に優しい人間だ。\nいきなり貴様に出来もしない事は科さん:
This may be sudden, but I am
as kind as a bodhisattva.
I won't make you do the
impossible right away.
strings.突然だがな、私は菩薩の様に優しい人間だ。\n貴様のような劣等生に無理難題は言わん:
This may be sudden, but I am
as kind as a bodhisattva.
I won't make unreasonable demands
of an underachiever like you.
strings.突然だがな、私は菩薩の様に優しい人間だ。\n貴様のような軟弱者に死んで欲しくはな:
This may be sudden, but I am
as kind as a bodhisattva.
I don't want a weakling
like you to die.
strings.突然だけど……あなた、\n昔を思い出したいと思わない？:
This is sudden, but... don't you
want to remember the old days?
strings.突然だけど、\n必殺技って必要だと思うの！:
This is sudden, but
I think finishing moves are a must!
strings.突然ですけど……。\n「スギナミ」とか「シナガワ」とかには、\nもう一つの世界が:
This is sudden, but...
I heard a rumor that in places like
"Suginami" and "Shinagawa,"
there's another world...
Do you know what that's about?
strings.突然ですけど正直に答えてください！ \nあの……。\nプチデモをしている人……。:
This is sudden, but
please answer honestly!
Um...
People who've done a Petit Demo...
What do you think of them?
strings.突然どうしたの？: What's this all of a sudden?
strings.突然ドラゴンのグッズを集め始めたり\nドラゴンだー！ って叫んだり……。:
He suddenly started
collecting dragon goods
and shouting "Dragon!" and stuff...
strings.突然立ち出でたお主のような者を\n闇雲に信用し、助けを乞うような愚、:
The folly of blindly
trusting one like you,
who appeared out of nowhere,
and begging for aid -
strings.突然襲ってきたりしないホ？:
They won't suddenly
attack, will they-ho?
strings.突貫で作ったから、今はそんなに\n凄い出来栄えではないし、:
I made it in a rush, so right now
it's not that impressive,
strings.立ち尽くす事にひた向きやったけん、\n声かけづらくて…。:
He was so devoted to standin' there
that it was hard to talk to him...
strings.立て続けに起きた、ホーム襲撃事件……。\nもちろん覚えているな？:
The string of Home attacks......
You remember, of course?
strings.立派にデビルバスターを\nやっているようだな。:
but it looks like
you're doing a fine job
as a Devil Buster.

but it looks like
you're doing a fine job
as a Devil Buster.
strings.笑わせるなよ！\n争いは不要だと？:
Don't make me laugh!
Conflict is unnecessary?
strings.笑顔でいるのは大事だよ。: Keeping a smile on is important.
strings.笑顔の天使「早瀬愛夢」、\nお菓子作りが得意な「渡辺まあり」、:
the smiling angel "Amu Hayase,"
the sweets-making expert
"Maari Watanabe,"
strings.笑顔は大事でしょうが、他人を傷つける笑いというものが存在すること\nそれだけは覚:
Smiles are important,
but please remember
that there is such a thing as
laughter that hurts others.
strings.第一、一度もくれたことないんですよ？\nだから今年もくれるはず無いんです。:
For one thing, she's
never given me any!
So there's no way she'll
give me any this year.
strings.第一君の聞きたいことはそれじゃないだろ！\n「多くのスイッチ」についてだろ！:
Besides, that's not
what you want to ask!
It's about the "lots
of switches," right!
strings.第三ホーム サキュバス前: Home III, in front of Succubus
strings.第三ホーム、新宿バベルの双方から\n入場している状況でございます。:
You have entered from both
Home III and Shinjuku Babel.
strings.第三ホームから入場の貴重品付与: Grant key item: entered from Home III
strings.第三ホームから行けるんだよ。: You can get there from Home III.
strings.第三ホームが恋しくなる場所。: A place that makes you miss Home III.
strings.第三ホームにいつもお酒をもって、\n酩酊してる人がいるって聞いたんだけど、\n何:
I heard there's someone at Home III
who always carries alcohol and is drunk.
Do you know anything?
Do they have good liquor over there?
I'm a little... very curious...
Alcohol is nice... it heals the soul...
strings.第三ホームにいる『お針子リリィ』に報告に行きましょう。:
Go report to "Lily the
Seamstress" at Home III.
strings.第三ホームにいる眼帯のオッサンも\nそう言ってたホ！:
The old guy with the
eyepatch in Home III
said so too, ho!
strings.第三ホームに比べて、\nこの街の空気って活気がある気がしないかしら？\nだからこ:
Compared to Home III,
don't you think the air
in this town is livelier?
That's why I love this town......
Don't you think so?
strings.第三ホームのどこに飛びたいんだ？\n突き進む！！ 、徹底的にな！(マッハ２):
Where in Home III ya wanna fly to?
Charge ahead!! All the way! (Mach 2)
strings.第三ホームのどこに飛びたいんだ？\n突き進む！！ 、徹底的にな！(マッハ３):
Where in Home III ya wanna fly to?
Charge ahead!! All the way! (Mach 3)
strings.第三ホームのどこに飛びたいんだ？\n突き進む！！ 、徹底的にな！(マッハ４):
